reviews.title: A good lunch outing from Srinagar !

Closer to Gulmarg , it offered amazing views of the snow peaks and valley . Easily comparable to any scenic place in the world . We requested the manager to give us  round of the property and were immediatly attended to .  The hotel offers very pleasant atmosphere , swimming pool , gym room , spa etc.  Could not see the rooms as they were fully booked because of a convention .  We decided to have lunch at their multi cuisine and had Indian ale carte .  The food and service was really nice and the restaurant offered good views through the big window glasses. It began to rain so had become quite cool and the air was so fresh .  All in all , a worthwhile lunch outing to make . I am sure it will be great to stay there overnight .

reviews.author: Akshat G
reviews.title: Great stay- heated pool was the highlight
reviews.text:
We had a good stay at The Khyber, Gulmarg, with several aspects that truly stood out, though we did feel a bit more could have been offered considering the premium price point.

The views from the room were absolutely stunning, overlooking the Himalayan mountain range - easily one of the highlights of our stay. The heated pool was excellent and very welcome in Gulmarg’s cold weather. Food and service at the food table were prompt, well-managed, and consistently very good.

That said, for a hotel of this category, we would have expected a few more comforts such as heated water in the flush and being provided with two key cards by default, which would have made the stay more convenient. At the same time, we do understand that maintaining a large luxury property in a remote, high-altitude town like Gulmarg comes with its own operational challenges, and we do acknowledge the effort that goes into keeping the hotel running smoothly in such conditions.

Special mentions go to Firdous at Cloves for attentive service, Wasim Yusuf, whose Rubab playing added a beautiful and calming cultural touch to the experience, and Owais at the spa/pool, who was very helpful and courteous.

Overall, a pleasant stay with memorable views, great food, and standout staff but with room for improvement to fully match its luxury positioning.

Give at least 2 key cards
Washroom seat should be heated or the water there should be heated.

reviews.text: It was beautiful in winters. We booked the Himalayan view, balcony room. Enjoyed every bit of the view, from the room and the bathtub. Service was OK, we wanted to order in-room from 'Brava', they told us on phone that the menu for this restaurant is available in the room QR code. After searching, didn't find, again called, then somebody else says that they don't serve in the room. This wasted a lot of time. Spa was exceptional! A must-try. Pool water was too hot for me, couldn't open eyes and swim. There is a kids playroom also. Overall a lot of things to do. Breakfast spread was good. Heating system is perfect.

reviews.author: Shampa R
reviews.title: An overall great experience except one complaint
reviews.text:
Our stay at the resort was truly wonderful. The picturesque setting, the comfortable rooms, the attentive staff -- all of it made for a memorable stay.  A special shout out to Firdous and Faisal who were very helpful and warm. 

That said, my spouse and I have one complaint.  We stayed in the resort for 4 nights and by the second night we began to feel uncomfortable by the way the staff (at the restaurants) kept reminding (in fact I would call it nagging) us to give them a good feedback. While we do appreciate their efforts and understand the importance of a god feedback, the constant reminder can become quite irritating for the guests. They kept at it relentlessly despite assurances that a good back would be given once we return to our hometown. Perhaps the management could gently instruct the staff not to do this for it became the only thing that was a blot on our otherwise perfect stay.

reviews.author: vishwanathanr20
reviews.title: Paradise in Hills- Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Nested amidst a forest tress in Gulmarg, this property has been made in an exquisite atmosphere. It has cast open spaces in the lounge and in every floor. A wonderful place to stay in a relaxed atmosphere.

The breakfast spread is great. Their staff like Shri Rayees take good care of you in the restaurant. The food was delicious and their Kachori was yummy.

We ordered room service and their staff Shri Ishfaq Bhat was prompt in service and courteous. 

The housekeeping staff led by Ms Nisbha really took care of our room.

While the resort deserves a 5 star, I gave 4 stars because it lacks air conditioning. In fact none of the hotels in Gulmarg have air conditioning as it is never required and all hotels are built for cold weather. I was told that this year due to unusual heat weather conditions they have decided to install air conditioning by next year. 

They will deserve a 7 star then.

reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: I spent one night at this resort and it was very beautiful. The location was excellent and close to the gondola spot. The rooms very spacious, but lacked AC. It was warm when I visited in August and I was rather surprised to find a 5-star resort without AC…so I didn’t sleep well. Every ~20 mins or so the electricity went off, and it appeared the resort did not have a generator as my room and hallways were entirely blacked out. Breakfast and dinner at the hotel restaurants offered a lot of variety and the food was delicious…although service was slow. Staff members were all nice. Although I did encounter a few annoyances during my visit, I do recommend this hotel and would stay here again!

reviews.author: Som_Roy
reviews.title: Luxury Amidst Nature - Outdoor activities could improve
reviews.text: Our recent 2-night stay at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa confirmed its reputation as the pinnacle of luxury in Kashmir. The resort boasts expansive rooms with breathtaking views, impeccable service, and a fantastic heated pool, all of which elevate the guest experience to extraordinary heights. However, while the resort excels in comfort and amenities, it falls short in integrating the natural allure of Gulmarg into its offerings. Visitors looking to engage in outdoor activities such as ATBs, skiing, or the Gondola ride will find themselves needing to arrange these externally, as the hotel does not provide these services. Despite this, the hospitality shown by staff members like Aijaz, Aamir, and Rayees in the restaurant was remarkable. Their professionalism and attentive service greatly enhanced our dining experiences and deserve special recognition. The Khyber is indeed a sanctuary of luxury, though a few more in-house outdoor services could make it truly unparalleled.

reviews.author: NicklasNavin
reviews.title: Superb resort but average food. No alcohol but BYO is fine
reviews.text:
I would agree with most reviewers here that the resort is truly amazing, and am not going to repeat what most have said about all the good things.
Instead, I will highlight some other things:

- The food isn't top notch.  Not what is expected from a 5 star resort this expensive. Also lacking local dishes.   Main restaurant Clove, where breakfast is also served, is very family oriented.  All tables are minimum 4 seaters, which was akward for me as a solo traveller, to occupy so much space when the place is busy and other guests are waiting for a table.  The breakfast itself again nowhere 5 star resort worthy, not enough variety, and the pastries/cakes were very dray on both my days.

-No alcohol served at the property.  But I knew this and came prepared :). At check-in they tell you it's totally fine to have your own liquor in your room or at the Hookah lounge in the evenings, where you can order your mixers and snacks as well.  This was one of my highlights.

-The massage at the Spa was a heaven and highly recommend.  Totally worth every penny.

Lastly, Mubashir at the Front Desk was a real superstar.

reviews.author: Vishal Mangtani
reviews.title: Visit with Family
reviews.text: Our Kashmir trip was for 8 nights in Mar 2023 of which we booked 2 nights in The Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa, Gulmarg. We booked Luxury balcony Himalayan view rooms, and the view of snow capped mountains with Chinar trees was breath-taking. We never felt like leaving the room since it was so luxurious, the bathroom was fit for a king, kids loved the bathtub and refused to get out of it. The only greed I could offer them more was the heated swimming pool which has glass walls on 2 sides overlooking the mountains.  The sauna, steam and jacuzzi were well maintained and my kids loved every bit of them. Breakfast covered all cuisines (English, south Indian ,north Indian, bakery) in which you would find something or everything to your liking. They need to include local food like Kashmiri breads in breakfast which i did not see. Promotion of local food is always a great plus point.  The food ordered in the room was delectable .The room service, front desk and coffee shop  staff are so warm ,they took special care of us. Needless to say this is highly recommended property for the breath-taking views, warm hospitality and proximity to Gondola rides . Thank you, The Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa, Gulmarg., for having us.

reviews.author: Vids
reviews.title: Surreal Experience at Meadows of flowers - The Khyber Gulmarg
reviews.text:
After much contemplations we decided to go to Kashmir for our short week long trip. 

We decided on two places to visit in Kashmir.. One was Gulmarg and another Srinagar as we were travelling with our 7 yr old daughter and a 1 yr old toddler... 

When it is Gulmarg then it's Khyber.. No second thoughts.. Though resort is the most expensive one with 40k per nights (off season) peak seasons are mostly sold out... But the experience is worth spending each penny..

The resort has two views - Gulmarg and Himalayan..

The Himalayan view is the highest category rooms when you can even see Gondola phase 1 and phase 2 cable car track. The rooms are equipped with all modern amenities, a big bath tub overlooking the Himalayas (Apar Parvat), the property, lush garden with beautiful flowers and roses, it had heater in the room, separate shower area, toilet area, separate closet with cupboards, a king size bed, sofa, balcony with big sitting area. We were allocated Room no. 2019 which is on the second floor and closer to Gym, swimming pool and spa area. 

There is one restaurant near the reception which is 'Cloves'. The staff is really pleasing and way too friendly and helpful.. In - room dining services is very quick and prompt.. We never faced any issue with our baby food we ordered in room or in the restaurant.. Special thanks to Mr Ashish, Chef Shahabaz and the serving staff Raees (always smiling and helpful).

Few other staff which made our stay more comfortable are Hamida (swimming pool), Omar (guard), Apsara (Spa).

However, I would like to express few low lights of our stay..  

At the time of check in we were informed that The sauna, jacuzzi, steam were out of order. For which Mr Mhd Rafi at the front desk had been very arrogant and his tone of response was completely unapologetic. They claim that they had informed their travel partner 15 days back of our stay ie 28th Aug (though we didn't received such notification) and if even they did it wouldn't have helped us as their non refundable policy gets over before 1.5 month of your stay dates. To which the response was "as if you are going to use this facilities for a whole day' it's just question of 1 hr. Which you would spend using these facilities so what's the big fuss.. You can any which ways use other facilities like swimming pool." Imagine the arrogance, one books such an expensive property  keeping in mind the facilities and amenities offered to the guest.. 

The swimming pool area was dirty and under maintenance with workers working to and fro carrying sacks of cement while you are swimming in the pool... We highlighted this to their management.. We were staying there for 4 days n 3 nights to enjoy the property and hospitality.. Would not have expected such an attitude from a premium property like this. 

After bringing it up time and again their GM Mr. Vinit Chabbra offered body massage at their spa.. That's what they could do to compensate for the inconvenience caused..which again was a reactive response.. However, we do appreciate this gesture from Mr. Chabbra but Mr. MHD Rafi  remained unapologetic. 

To the contrast we had wonderful experience with their restaurant staff at 'Cloves' .Special mention of Raees, Mr Ashish, Chef Shahabaz. 

The breakfast  spread@Cloves was elaborate. With dosas, omlettes, juices, kahwa, deserts /breads, other breakfast items like poha, upma, idli, wada, khakra, fafda (seems like they expect lot of Gujarati tourist). My favourite being cold coffee and Kaali (masala fresh lime soda). They didn't serve lunch and dinner buffet due to low occupancy.. However on our request they did serve dinner buffet on the last day of our stay which was not elaborate however worth trying. 

Overall the stay was very comfortable with great housekeeping and restaurant staff. Amazing surreal views, spacious rooms.. Worth spending time and money at The Khyber.

reviews.author: vmaloo
reviews.title: Serenity
reviews.text:
The Khyber is a property where the hype precedes the visit. A majestic hotel nestled amidst refreshing pine forests, it certainly is a resort beautifully made. While we had booked Premier Rooms, we got this changed to the Luxury Room Himalayan View, the room with the balcony overlooking the forests and the mountains and this decision was something we did not regret. 

The hotel only had one operational restaurant during our stay, the multi cuisine Clove (unsure if it has others) and we were pleasantly surprised by the taste of the food. Generous portions, excellent service and tasty food were a consistent experience there. 

The reason why we wanted to visit Khyber is when we saw pictures of the spa and the swimming pool, both enclosed in glass structures to help enjoy the grand view outside. While the view was true to the pictures and the pool was heated (oh, the relaxing feeling when you enter!), the health club is the area where Khyber’s claim of “there’s absolutely nothing spoilt here besides you” shows signs of cracking. The gym was unmanned every time I visited, while the pool only had one attendant who was usually busy running errands. This single male attendant was responsible for running the whole show, including the female changing areas. This is something that is unacceptable. The steam room produced no steam and the cleanliness in this area was subpar. However, in all honesty, entering the heated pool and looking out of the floor-to-glass ceiling to the untouched Himalayan sight made me forget all of this in a jiffy. 
The spa experience was unexpected, and not in a good way. During the therapy, construction and maintenance work was going on, phones were constantly ringing and people were talking, breaking the expected experience of being transported away in a world with zen-like calm. While the whole property is beautifully build with wood, making the therapy rooms soundproof and adding a carpet to the wooden flooring in the spa would go a long way as we could hear every person walking outside the therapy room. The therapists, while claimed to be highly experienced with special training from L'occitane, never asked for prior injuries and while the therapy was not bad, it was not great either. While all of these were excusable, the coup de grace was about to come. On complaining about these to the spa manager (who I will not name here), she refused to believe us, saying the construction was stopped within 5 minutes and the other noises were due to the cleaning staff when we could see people with hammers entering and exiting the spa. Her final conclusion to this conversation was ‘let me know if you want to do the therapy or not within 5 minutes. What is the point of having this conversation?’

The recreational area had table tennis, carrom, foosball, snooker and a non-functioning air hockey table, all of which we highly enjoyed. It also had a theatre which guests can book and enjoy movies in, available to guests on a chargeable basis, but we never ended up using it. 

The Khyber is an impressive property with views unlike any other. It is beautifully built with well thought-of features and is highly maintained. While some areas still need the polish of a Taj or an Oberoi, this trip made me realise that the people at the hotel can change the experience you have and everyone here at Khyber greet you with smiles and are extremely helpful. While some people can absolutely ruin your experience, others can turn it into an amazing one, and I want to call out some names who helped make this experience such an amazing one: Mr. Ishfaq Bhat at customer relations, Ab Qadir at the restaurant, Rahul, the barista and especially Irfan Hussain at the front desk and Mr. Rafi Bhat, the duty manager, who have time and again helped us to make the stay comfortable. You guys made Khyber live up to its massive hype. A big shout out to them and everyone else at Khyber.

reviews.author: Maul
reviews.title: Luxurious and grande
reviews.text:
Once you enter the hotel you know it is the best property you will find in all of Kashmir. People come to Kashmir specially to stay at The Khyber and I must say, the hype is real. 

Rooms: we stayed in the Premium category room which is a bit bigger and with a private balcony with a beautiful view. We had a walk-in closet and the rest of the bathroom was quite spacious too. The rooms are luxurious! However, this category of rooms can be a long walk away from the restaurant downstairs. 

Food: no complaints about the quality and quantity here. The spread is lavish and top class. The service however was a letdown. The staff was sometimes not at their best - their communication and speed had become a big problem for our group of 15. It got so bad that we had to take this up with the management. 

Spa & Pool: could describe the spa in one word - overpriced. I got a 60min massage and I wasn't fully satisfied with my masseur but the women's masseuse was pretty good for my wife & mom. They do have steam & sauna services. The pool used to be quite packed due to the amount of guests at the hotel so we didn't spend a lot of time there but the pool area is a vibe - just spend some time here early morning or evening after 7pm.

- it was snowing heavily on our check in day and our cab couldn't make it up their slope so I called reception (which takes forever to answer) to send us any 4x4 vehicle of their property which we were absolutely denied without any hesitation. - Room service was just garbage, everything took longer than usual to be executed, they didn't have candles in their housekeeping, housekeeping staff lost one of our lens case during clean up which was left on washbasin counter, we were denied to eat fresh fruits from breakfast buffet as we were checking out early though they provided us with packed breakfast.

reviews.author: Aditya Mehta
reviews.title: Gulmarg- a place to visit for the snow & view
reviews.text:
Pros:

Right from the airport the pick up was very smoothly done by Asif- representative from Khyber at the airport & he helped with the departure to Bombay as well. 

The driver Akram & tour guide Bilal also were really warm,friendly and ensured we had a good time sightseeing or with the gandola activities etc.

We were lucky to probably get the last room available at the hotel. We stayed in a single room cottage and room was very spacious with balcony on both ground and first floor. Except we were 3 people so had to put an additional bed for one of us.

The view from the room balcony and from different parts of the hotel was great and that’s the biggest USP of the hotel I would say. 

Staff was very prompt and they were just a phone call away. Be it room service or housekeeping etc.

Cons:

As for the food,the local kashmiri food was good and rest was pretty average I would say. The hotel was at full capacity but the food could’ve been much better. 

Price wise as well all food was above 1000 Rs which even for 5 star standards is on the expensive side.Also a lot of the food was fried & given which is not something we liked and had to ask them to make the dish again.

Also since except Skiing & all snow activities there was not much to do,we enquired about the cinema they had. The cost was Rs 15,000 + GST regardless of no of people if its 2 or 15 people. We found this very expensive and not even worth considering.

The entire staff asked after her health constantly - truly one experiences the beauty, kindness, selflessness, hospitality and goodness of Kashmir!!!. The restaurant staff and the chef paid a great deal of attention to all my meals as I have diary and gluten allergy - the chef personally curated and prepared my food - which was excellent. The yellow dal and guchi pulao are one of the best meals I have had. They made fresh almond milk and vegetable juices for me for breakfast. It was a disappointment that the pool was shut due to covid. The gym is fantastic. I think the hotel would be more stunning and value for money in winter when it is covered by snow.

reviews.author: IndiaTravelfreak
reviews.title: The Only paradise in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
If you have managed to finally get a booking for this hotel, consider yourself lucky especially in winters. The gorgeous views that you get of the snow and the mountains in winters from this hotel cannot be missed by staying somewhere else. 

Khyber has a touch of royalty in this vast resort uphill from the main and small Gulmarg. Highly secure and a friendly front staff and the resort staff, this resort gives us a complete luxurious experience from its amazing indoor heated swimming pool, to its magnificent pampering spa and its kahwah and bakery lounge. 

The rooms are spread across different wings and floors and becomes slightly challenging if you are at the end of the resort. Rooms are cosy but slightly dated and not much noise proof and so needs refurbishment at the earliest. Bathroms are good sized and best part is the always available hot water and heater in the rooms and bathrooms especially in winters. 

Food was great and buffet had a lot of variety in its spread daily. All the activities are in the vicinity from ATV and market and the Gondola is just 5 mins walk from the hotel to go up to the mountains. 

The only recommended place to stay in Gulmarg to add that zing to your vacation. Am back there again for sure.

reviews.author: Rajeshcounto
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel in midst of The ranges
reviews.text:
Stayed for 4 nights - the rooms are very spacious and with a wonderful view of the ranges / the valley .. the hotel lobby is finished in wood and gives a first approach wow - the staff is friendly , I was told that they have over 400 staff for 70 rooms - over staffed  but lack motivation - food quality is reasonably good but over priced  - they lack a proper travel counter who can guide the visitors about the do’s and don’ts 
Ideal hotel to stay when in Gulmarg - it’s more a 3 star plus hotel - doesn’t qualify for a 5 star status

reviews.author: Shalini B
reviews.title: My 7th stay at Khyber Resort & Spa Gulmarg !!!
reviews.text:
It has always been such a pleasure to stay at this Resort as it is the Team which makes it so wonderful !!!
It is the smiling faces that we see here who work tirelessly so that we the guests can have a good time stress free !
This time around it was not so great though...
Aarif Bhat at the Front Office is a fabulous guy ! The entire check in process was smooth and very well taken care of by him ! He is such a soft spoken person and extremely polite.
Also the check out was handled by him like a piece of cake !
A big thank you to Aarif Bhat !
Junaid who was with him also was 👍🏼👍🏼
The F&B Manager Bilal who is a familiar face and always smiling was always on the go and ever ready to help with anything that one may need.
So happy that he is there and my “Go To” person for everything !!
Firdous & Adil, these two will do anything to make your meal experience satisfactory !
Always there with a smile on their face to serve and cater to all your food needs !
A big shout out to all three of them !
Unfortunately I was encountered with an extremely rude and arrogant person handling F&B by the name of Mukesh !
This man needs to really know what it is to be in the hospitality industry !

reviews.author: Deepthi S
reviews.title: A wonderful place to stay!
reviews.text:
I and my husband stayed here in Feb 2021. The resort is beautifully nestled between mountains. One can see the opulence upon entering the hotel's main entrance. The reception staff aren't very active in receiving guests as would be expected in a 5 star. That being said, the restaurant staff are one of the most hospitable and courteous that you can find. Special mention to Mr.Govind and Mr.Iqbal for their great service and ever smiling and pleasant behaviour. Also the manager, a tall, lean, bespectacled person (I don't recollect his name), was also very courteous, sometimes even removing our plates after we were done. They always asked us about our day and if we were enjoying the food. They are a true representation of customer service and hospitality.

The rooms are very cozy and the heating system is top notch. Even when the temperature outside is sub zero, you will feel very normal inside the room. 

One small thing that can be improved is the shower. It had temperature control but did not have flow control. Or maybe it was just with our room. So every time you want hot water, the flow will be at the maximum. This is a waste of water and can be worked upon. 

We had all our meals there itself. The buffet spread was average, nothing special to write about. However the ala carte food is delicious. You should definitely try their mutton biriyani, for that matter any of their mutton dishes. They should really concentrate on improving their buffet spread. Both taste and variety need to be worked upon.

Overall it's the best place to stay in Gulmarg. There are few improvements that are needed but this is an experience not to be missed.

reviews.author: SumitIndianTraveller
reviews.title: Great location, good food, decent service.
reviews.text:
Travelled to Gulmarg in 1st week of January 2020. The intention was to enjoy snow as much as we can since there is none in New Delhi. I had booked 3 nights stay at Khyber from Makemytrip in november but as i got near to January i was worried if flights are cancelled due to bad weather what will happen to my hotel booking. But all went well and we reached Kashmir-heaven on Earth. I had arranged my transfer from Srinagar airport to Khyber and back  with the hotel. It is a little expensive(INR 3500 each way) but they take care of everything then. As soon as i landed there was a person from hotel waiting in the luggage belt area. Got luggage and moved towards Gulmarg. The car sent was a 4x4 scorpio which surely is required to drive n the snow from Tangmarg-Gulmarg. Till Tangmarg the roads are clean and a normal car works but not from Tangmarg-Gulmarg.It was constantly snowing and there was a lot of snow on the road which made it slippery as well. On way to Gulmarg the driver assisted in renting the boots required for walking in snow from Tangmarg as normal shoes won't work in 5ft or more of snow.Always bargain everywhere in Kashmir. They ask for 3 times the normal prices for everything. 
On reaching the hotel was given welcome drink kashmiri Kahva-great taste. After the check-in formalities was shown way to my room which was what i booked a luxury balcony room with Gulmarg view. I would surely recommend everyone to book a balcony room to enjoy snow. Though you can hardly sit outside for long but having a balcony surely has its charm. The problem i faced before reaching Kashmir was i tried to connect with hotel several times and a lot of times the reservation person does not pick up the phone. 
The property is built with taste and i believe a lot of effort. The resort is centrally heated which is surely required.There is gym,heated pool , jacuzzi ,steam ,sauna in the hotel. The hotel also has a kids play area but it is next to nothing. I believe the snow is the best thing to play here for kids. The gym was decent with good views and working machines. 

Room: The room was spacious with central heating. Had a separate shower and a bath tub. Enough space for luggage , had a locker in the almirah , tea coffee, water sufficient in the room. The property is running old and they are not refurbishing things like the sofa in the room was in a very bad shape. It had lost all the cushioning and was dirty as well. No one cleaned balcony in 3 days and when i requested that there is too much snow in the balcony then they sent someone to clean it. The room has a desk but you cannot work on it. Not a good design to put a laptop and work. 

Spa/swimming pool: On the website it was mentioned that the pool is under renovation but it was operational when i reached hotel. Now the hotel sells the swim suits etc at exorbitant prices. the pool surely has the best views of snow clad mountains. The spa is not the best. The steam room does not work properly and someone needs to check that. There was hardly an attendant in the spa area. 

The property is minutes from the famous Gondola ride which will take you the mountains to enjoy the beauty of Kashmir. Though there are people at the resort who would want to be your guide for a fee but i recommend to enjoy yourself. Just walk down the road and take left and you will be at the ticket counter for Gondola. The guide / car hiring / sledging etc all are quoted 3 times by the people outside the resort. So bargain for everything.One of the days i just walked from the resort to the Gulmarg main market and there was no problem except people troubling you to hire sledges or car or take guide. 

Food: The food was good on all occasions here. 2 out of 3 nights we had the buffet as the manager offered us 1+1 deal on the buffet. Prices for a-la-carte are too steep. Breakfast was decent ,loved the south Indian dosa that they prepare. 

The hotel does not serve alcohol but you are welcome to get your own and drink in their shish lounge. They do serve shish and some snacks there. 

Phones : Were not working in Gulmarg. I had vodafone which did not have any signal in Gulmarg. Reliance & Airtel i believe work.

Last word: The hotel is not the best 5 star property i have stayed in but surely it a commendable job done at such height. The prices they are charging are a little on higher side but i thing to maintain this property in Kashmir surely is a big task.

reviews.author: prernasinha2000
reviews.title: The Khyber Resort & Spa- Luxurious And The Best Option In Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Rooms
It is a 85-room resort with beautiful views of the valley and the Himalayas. Wooden ceilings, luxurious interiors and spacious rooms are some of the wonderful features of this resort. Our room had a balcony with majestic views of the Himalayas. While the morning and the evenings were chilly, with the temperatures dropping to almost 0 degrees, the days are lovely and we would step out or even sit with a book in the balcony.

Cottages
Apart from the rooms they also have an option of the cottages with a private hideaway.

Fitness centre
They a reasonable size gym with well appointed machines, dumbbells and other accessories. There are separate sauna and steam facilities as well as jacuzzis. Again the views from here make winter workouts interesting.

Swimming Pool
The one feature that is covered in almost all the magazines is their heated indoor swimming overlooking the snow laden coniferous forest. It’s a luxury you understand when you are in a cold, freezing atmosphere.

Kids play area- IGLOO
This was well equipped but at the basement and we tried going there twice but it was deserted so we skipped the same. They also have a games room if you want to catch a quick round of snooker or billiards.

The Den
They have the concept of the Den which is where you can watch movies of your choice but we never got the time to check this one out. Restaurants

Cloves
Most of our meals were eaten here. The breakfast has an amazing lay and for dinner and lunch they have a buffet and an ala carte option. I thought the food was pretty decent.

If you are a non-vegetarian then their Kashmiri thali is a must-try though you might need two people to finish it off.

Nouf
Nouf has to be booked in advance and in our usual hurried trip style we never ended up doing the same but it is supposed to have stunning views from every direction. Freshly grilled meats, cooked just the way you like on traditional coal-fired barbecues. Nouf is ideal for a cozy dinner by the candlelight. Definitely on my list for the next time.

Chaikash
Think of it as their coffee shop. It is just next to their lobby and perfect place to lounge and have tea or Kahwa. Their Kahwa is absolutely delicious and for us it became an evening routine to just sit their with our books and chat and indulge in some couple time here.

Do not forget to create a snowman and indulge in some snow fights while you are surrounded 

OTHER ACTIVITIES
Trekking and Fishing
Treks are closed in winters but if you head here in a slightly bearable weather the the trek to Khilanmarg Valley to see spring flowers is supposed to be enchanting. If you are an adventure seeker then you can trek to the serene Alpather Lake. For fishing enthusiasts  Ningle Nallah and the Ferozepur Nallah are streams famous for trout fishing.

reviews.author: niravtalsania
reviews.title: Gulmarg a winter destination
reviews.text:
The best hotel in Gulmarg , located right next to the Gondola, which is the cable car ride to 14000 ft summit of the local Himalayas, the chief attraction of Gulmarg.
Food is good, could be better,especially the Indian cuisine.But its quite expensive, both food and stay , so be ready to go light on your wallets.
Beware of locals , they exist to fleece tourists, bargaining is a must, the bargain rate is fixed at 50% of what is quoted by the locals if you have good bargaining power.
Guides are not needed at all, you can directly go to gondola from the hotel, the drivers will tell you the guides will stand in lines for tickets for the gondola etc, hire a guide only if the line is very long, that too dont pay him more 300,400 rs.
Hotel staff is very courteous, and oh very Islamic. So they dont serve booze and no joint serves booze either in the entire resort town, so best carry your own, especially if you rely on a swig of cognac to get through cold nights.

reviews.author: Anurag Mehrotra
reviews.title: One of its kind ! Amazing stay !
reviews.text:
We stayed in Khyber from the 8th to the 10th Feb 2018, we were greeted by Kahva, a beautiful young lady escorted us to the coffee shop for checking in was a breeze.

The resort was all snow capped and resembled a winter wonderland. However it was full to its capacity and I could see people waiting for a breakfast table.

We had booked for a luxury balcony room with Gulmarg view, DO NOT BOOK THIS ROOM, Make sure you book the ROOM with Himalayan view. The sunken bath tub in the room is alright, however it was a little dirty on arrival and we had to call house keeping to clean it. They were quick and efficient though.

Food is decent and alcohol is served in the evening due to Govt Regulations. They even have a Lounge serving Sheesha, dint try it but looked good. 

Room dinning was excellent with enough options, considering it a 5 star property, I would say the food is up to the mark and reasonable.

The Pool was the highlight of our stay, its flawless, spectacular view, I would say. Even better than the one at Taj Madikeri.

The hotel is beautiful in itself, the best you can have in Gulmarg.

Highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Tejas J
reviews.title: The best in Gulmarg !!
reviews.text:
I had visited this property in first week of march for 3 nights. Let me be clear this is a no where close to 5 star property,unlike other grand 5 stars I have stayed at, they only have one restaurant and neither they have any activities for their guests, however this is the best luxury property Gulmarg has currently.(and only one with heated pool ) 

We had booked  Luxury room Gulmarg View but upgraded it to Himalayan view and the view was worth the extra bucks. Our check in was seamless , being offered to sit in lobby area while our formalities were being taken care of .At check in Mr Sakib from front desk was assisting us, and we requested him if there were any room with Himalayan view were available to which he promptly replied "yes there are and that will be additional".We requested him that we need to see his senior(to discuss the upgrade thing), he went inside was back in 30 seconds saying that his senior is busy in a meeting,to which we asked him to see us whenever he is available, and without any fuss we checked in our room.I was expecting his senior to call me or meet me during my 3 nights stay but not once did Sakib or his senior bothered to call or ask. Pretty arrogant  and very unprofessional attitude for front desk staff and not expected especially when you are being charged a bomb.
My room's remote wasn't working and neither was the telephone handset, even the indirect lighting weren't working,this didn't bothered me but this small things which always matters.

the positives
1) Majority of staff will sport sweet Kashmiri smile on their face.
   Special mention for Restaurant staff Aijaz, Iqbal, Irfan for their superb hospitality and       their senior Mr Mukesh, (F and B manager) .Trust me this team is only reason we had all meals in restaurant inspite of not booking all meals package.Front desk Ms Pakeeza is also very helpful and always available at your disposal, sadly our interaction happened only during check out.
2) we did not book for all meals package and I suggest don't, as their al Carta menu is extensive and the food is yummy.we had all 6 meals there, it costs us much lesser than  all meals package
3) Spa by locctaine is good and the rates are on par with other star hotels
4) heated pool 
Gulmarg itself is beautiful and you will be wowed by Gulmarg's beauty.
A must visit place to people to who want to have luxury at their disposal at remotest location and don't shelling out extra.

reviews.title: Best view
reviews.text:
We've just had the best experience staying at the Khyber for a few days and it couldn't have been possible without the help of Mr.Irfan from the front office. He was helpful and knew how to treat his guests.

Mr.Shyam, the F&B manager, was extremely generous and helpful which made every meal at the Khyber a memorable one.

Mr. Burhan received us when we checked in and showed us around and was very kind when we needed help. 

Mr. Firdous makes the best Seesha. Thank you all.

reviews.author: Nidhi G
reviews.title: Nidhi
reviews.text:
This was my second trip to Khyber Himalayan resort. It’s a wonderful resort & must say it’s an all season place to be for a relaxing & comfortable holiday.
The hospitality extended by the staff is really commendable , especially Sakib at the front desk. 
He was a 1 stop for all our queries & needs.

reviews.author: king_kl
reviews.title: Luxurious & secured
reviews.text:
Due to strike our driver/guide advised us to start Early. We reached the hotel way before our check in. Management told us to wait for an hour for check in. Our stay was very short and we had to start the next day also early. All this was explained and we were provided with a temporary room for refreshing and later guided to our actual room. Hotel is rich and safe. Need a couple of days to explore the hotel itself. We couldnt utilize any of the facilities offered due to lack of time. Looks like there was no proper communication as the front desk was not notified about my early check out which i had explained clearly while checking in. They were asking me why i did not inform them Prior. And they also forgot to provide us our welcome drink :(
Anyways Mr.Hameed was very courteous and guided us to our room. Another incident to mention - i lost my gold ring and bangle in gym there and totally forgot it. I noticed this only next day while checking out. Mr.Irfaq(hope the name is right) from jammu helped me and took it from lost & found . I will not forget this timely help by Mr.Irfaq who is very patient and polite. Mr.Irfaq and Mr.Hameed will be the only reason for my next stay with this hotel.

reviews.author: Anupriya Singhal
reviews.title: Luxury nestled in paradise
reviews.text:
Needless to say it is the best resort in Gulmarg & hence everything is amazing but what does surprise you here is the service & how the place & the staff make you feel like its home. We were a big group aitgbkids and we would make the lounge area our sitting place & sit there for hours with the food & the snacks being served there for us. You have to carry your own alcohol but they are super sweet about ice & glasses etc. The Spa is a MUST - the services are outstanding. But all is not hunky dory - the food for one is quite average & the pool wasn’t clean. 

Definitely a hotel that should be on your list of places to explore

reviews.author: arenski
reviews.title: another annual skiing week
reviews.text:
This will be our 4th consecutive annual stay at khyber. Everything remains the same as previous years.
Beautiful and luxurious rooms. Great location.
Swimming Pool and the Jacuzzi is top notch.
Spa is expensive but brilliant.
Service remains a concern.
Food is a major disappointment. Breakfast and dinner buffet needs to be fresh. someone staying for a day or two will not realise that the food served at buffet is not fresh. Staying for a week you would know that food and fruits being served not fresh. Must have been frozen a few times. Order A la carte and the food is tasty and fresh.
Chose to have dinner at highland park on a couple of occasions and was a delight. Plus massive quantities for every dish.
Getting in and out of khyber every day is still very painstaking. 
Will sincerely request the management to improve the buffet quality.
Stayed for a week March 2018.

reviews.author: Sazia S
reviews.title: Very good!
reviews.text:
The views with snow were amazing. Hospitality, comfort and food were excellent.
We had a memorable stay. Looking forward to going back in another season too. Thank you Khyber for making our holiday so good.

reviews.author: sal30
reviews.title: What the reception lacks in welcome- the restaurant team more than makes up for it
reviews.text:
First things first - we enjoyed our stay here so much that we're already planning for next Jan. We were here for a two day ski trip and got in to the hotel by 12pm. We had emailed earlier asking for a valley view not knowing that our valley view stared out into a hut like structure. We asked for it to be changed to the other side but were met with a lot of resistance at the reception since they said we had asked for this view- we admitted we did not know and were happy to pay any change charge to the other view. However, for some reason the reception staff seemed to keep disappearing on us which is not exactly what you want after long travel. Fortunately one manager seemed proactive and asked us to have lunch while he sorted it out (which he did fairly quickly after he took over - the rest just seemed to not know what they were doing). 
In contrast we walked over to the restaurant and Mukesh, Junaid, Bilal etc were just fabulous. From the start to the time we left, they went out of their way to ensure we were comfortable and happy. They are partly the reason we will head back. 
The other of course is the view and the fact that it is the best hotel in terms of facilities which is great when traveling with younger ones.
In short - 
We loved our stay at Khyber and will definitely be back next ski season 
Loved the food - do not miss the trout at the restaurant 
Get the mountain view (we learnt this the hard way) with balcony sit out - its like staring at a picture postcard 
The pool is wonderful and relaxing so do carry swimwear 
Kahwa at Chaikash is amazing and truly appreciated after a day long of sking
Mukesh, Junaid, Bilal and all of the restaurant crew - thank you !!

reviews.author: Muhammad A
reviews.title: brilliant staff
reviews.text:
The hotel is located next to the Gondola ... so has a perfect location being on the highest level of the land.
The building, rooms, were all average to be honest, compared to the price being paid.
The only significant thing about the hotel was the staff and the food.
The staff was amazing, in every department/place.
I was received by Burhaan, very decent guy who handled my check in and showed me the room. 
I'd like to thank the restaurant managers, both were superb and very decent. I was seated for dinner then because I had this headache I opted to get back to my room, they made it so easy and Abd-Allateef brought me the food to my room, another decent and polite man.
The next day I checked out , and had to rush so couldn't get enough time for breakfast, Iqbal from the restaurant packed something for me to eat on the road.

Overall it was a nice stay, comfortable, mainly because of the staff. 
Not complaining about the rooms though, they were as seen on photos, but frankly not worth the money spent as they weren't that fancy. but the staff was really welcoming and brilliant.
Onething I noticed, they some kept on calling me " brother ", which may sound unprofessional however I enjoyed it, being a muslim we tend to use brother with all, but furthermore it made me feel home.

I'd probably stay there again if I visit, for the sake of the view and the staff

reviews.author: Jay_Banglore2018
reviews.title: Royalty at the roof of the world!!!!
reviews.text: This is our very first stay in The Khyber .... no words to describe this place..... the hotel reception and the common areas are decked with lavishness and royalty.... but the room( where we were put up) itself seemed a little old fashioned smaller than we expected .....can’t say it was worth the price we paid for .... but i can’t deny the fact that it had a stunning view of the mountain peak  at such close range.... it was surreal!!!!.... and the bathtub was put to good use by my little one....the Gondola ride station is only a stones throw from the Khyber.....which is really amazing as we can get back to the warmth of our room as soon as we finish our ride.... there are other activities in the hotel to entice us like the spa and various food lounges.... but as we just stayed for one day/ night, we weren’t able to explore much..... a special mention has to be made to the breakfast buffet... really grand!!!.....don’t know if we’ll ever check-in to Khyber again..... but we had an experience we’ll cherish for a lifetime!!!!

reviews.author: R1C
reviews.title: serene place with very friendly staff
reviews.text:
I highly recommend this place specially for families with kids. The place is really really beautiful and peaceful. It is pricier compared to most hotels but u get what u paid for. You get your money’s worth. We booked a basic room and it is quite spacious. I f u can shell out some more, go for the room with a balcony. I travelled with my wife and 2 kids aged 2 and 4. no charge for my kids since they are just young and they shlept with us in our king bed. We really enjoyed our stay. The lobby is very welcoming and cozy. u dont even need to queue to checkin. They will approach u and bring u to a comfy lounge and serve u the kawha, a very nice tasting welcome tea. You will just sign the form after you drink your tea and thats it, you’re already checked in. Great start after a tiring connecting flight from Delhi. 

It has a very nice and intricate interior design. Tha staff are very friendly. Special mention to Sohail and also Hamid. They are like friends already during our 3 days stay. They are very nice to us and treated us like we knew each other already. made our stay quite memorable. We even has a picture together before we left the place. We love the swimming pool my kids love to swim and since it is winter, it is a  plus to have a heated pool. I think this is the only hotel in the area with heated pool. They also have an indoor play area that our kids enjoyed. However, it is not well maintained and a bit dark. I am also not confident to leave my kids there because just outside the play room is a door leading to the outside area and no staff or security personnel guarding the door. 

The restaurant has a very nice view. There is also a hug balcony where outside the lounge area where the guests can stay and enjoy the snow without leaving the hotel premises. Food is nice, since we are not locals, it is great to have a few options for western food. My kids cannot take spicy foods yet and curry. that is a huge plus for us. The only thing that I think they can improve is to add more variety for breakfast. I am expecting more variety for this price range. Also no western food except for the omelette. Almost all food in the breakfast are local foods. Not a big deal for many I guess but since we have kids, it was a bit of a problem for us. And at this price range aroud 400usd/night, food variety should be much better. But overall, it was truly an amazing place and we had a wonderful stay.

reviews.author: bachher s
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text:
What a lovely place to stay!
Was a great experience, location just perfect, good cooperative staff, delicious food, good massage experience. 
Loved the place, highly recommended.
1 star less for the untidy pool. Sorry to the management but should take care.

reviews.author: parul s
reviews.title: Super stay with stunning views of the pir Panjal
reviews.text: We just returned after a 3 nights stay at the Khyber , we had a fantastic stay which was smooth from the check in till the day we left . The food is great and there’s a huge variety of vegetarian food on the menu , the cottages are spic and spacious and they are much much better and bigger than what the website shows ( please take better pictures and repost )and the service is extremely prompt and the staff is very friendly and warm. The F&B manager Mukesh took great care of the food that was served to us and was always will to accommodate our demands . Asrar at the reception assured that we wasted no time checkin in.The staff is polite and always smiling and courteous... Enjoyed my stay to the fullest - definitely worth a trip .

reviews.author: MlAJAPAN
reviews.title: きれいですが。
reviews.text:
ホテルの雰囲気も良く、部屋やプールからの雪景色は最高の眺めです。スタッフの対応も良し！
また、ホテルにドクターが常駐しており、不調の折来ていただいたところ、とてもよく診ていただき助かりました。

難点をあげれば、連泊中のルームメイクはひどく、ベッドを整え、ゴミを捨てただけでした。アメニティの補充なし、床に落ちたクズはそのまま。
バスルームはシャワーにも問題あり。
辛かったのが、横の部屋のテレビの音が丸聞こえで眠れなかったことです。
これはボリュームの問題というよりも、壁の異常な薄さだと思いました。

いいホテルではあるのですが、宿泊料金に見合っていないようにも思いました。

reviews.author: roopali agrawal
reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text:
Hi, 

We had a stay at the hotel from 28Jan to 30 Jan. The hotel has all the amenities like a good well maintained Gym, a heated swimming pool, steam , sauna and jacuzzi.My 4 yrs old son enjoyed the heated pool. The view from our room was beautiful, as it was snowing both the days.
The food and the hospitality is good.

reviews.author: JASJIT S
reviews.title: Truly a lap of luxury
reviews.text:
The Khyber stands out and stands tall in Gulmarg. From the time you step out of the car and into the lobby, the warm hospitality of the staff hits you. 
Great rooms all with superb view in each one of them. Excellent heating. Great facilities.
It’s an experience worth having if you can fit it into your budget. 
Some minor negatives that can be and should be recitified. It’s difficult to walk up to the property. I feel the hotel should provide a free service to their clients. 
The evening room service is not so good. Replenishment of tea, water, turning of sheets is non-existent. However, I have to say, once you ask for this, it comes in no time at all. 
Secondly, I think the food leaves a lot to be desired. It is not really fine dining, but it’s definitely not value for money. For dinner you have virtually no choices and the buffet is too highly priced. The management seriously needs to look into this. This is a common complaint that I overheard from friends traveling with me and others who have been here before.
Now for the team. Pakeezah is a wonderful hostess. Bubbly, lively and makes you feel welcome from the word go. Sameer at the Sheesha Lounge was warmth and excellence personified. Khyber has a fine team and it should be proud of the same.

reviews.author: Kunal S
reviews.title: Luxury property with a fantastic location
reviews.text: Luxurious property with great rooms. Since we travelled in the last week of December the heating was extremely good all over the property. We even used the heated pool, its perfect since the water is lukewarm. The only disappointment was the food from the buffet which was ok but this was more than made up by the excellent service of Mr Tawheed and team who made some fresh food as per our requests. Overall the best property in Gulmarg by far.

reviews.author: LiveWhileAlive
reviews.title: Perfect, Almost
reviews.text:
Arrival was very welcoming, the staff are terrific. The location is amidst snow-covered mountains and pine trees, beautiful views all around, one couldn't do better with the location. The gondola ride is a 5 minute walk down the road, but if you are older or not used to walking in the snow, then get a ride. The restaurant offers excellent food choices, although a bit expensive. 

Couple points, we had a room with twin beds, this typically means two separate beds, but here the beds are joined, we had to ask them to separate these beds, yet I could hear my freind snore. My friend left his boots in the cloak room, and a hotel guest took his boots, the staff traced the guest, sent a couple staff members and got the boots back. Every time they erred, they fixed it, every single time.

That said, to be honest and fair, I would say they are a good solid 4 star hotel, compared to places such as The Monasterio in Lima, Peru. Even a 4.5, but don't let that take away anything from this beautiful, well managed, friendly place. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: ApurvNagpal
reviews.title: Great property - needs better service, lower pricing
reviews.text: The property is beautiful, truly amazingly constructed, with lots of wood, natural elements feel. There is a golf course nearby, as well as the cable car - all walking distance. They have a lovely indoor pool, which thanks to its glass walls, has a very open feel. The staff is friendly. However - I found the rates quite exorbitant, especially given the occupancy which was close to nil when I was there. Also, quite surprisingly, I was given a room with a view of the parking lot. When questioned why it wasn't a better view, was told it's what I had booked and would have to pay extra for a better view. This is when the hotel is empty. BTW - the hotel also doesnt serve alcohol (which I think should be mentioned clearly on the site) but apparently doesnt mind if you get your own.

reviews.author: Pradeep K
reviews.title: Excellent stay at Khyber. Thanks Roamland Holidays
reviews.text: We booked a package based on our friend's reference with Roamland Holidays which is Kashmir based travel company. Everything went well from stay & transportation. Overall, my family enjoyed & we had a great time in the lap of nature. We certainly recommend to travel & stay at least a night at Khyber Himalayan Resort in Gulmarg. On a side note, we are thankful to team Roamland Travel for making our tour a comfortable & hassle free.

reviews.author: manish b
reviews.title: One of the best experiences in Kashmir
reviews.text: This property is located in the middle of the forest with breathtaking views from the rooms. Rooms are beautifully done and have all the comforts of a luxury hotel. Staff is very warm and welcoming. This hotel is one of the reasons, I would want to visit Kasmir again.

reviews.author: shyam845455
reviews.title: Good service
reviews.text: I stay there for two night I feel happy with my comfortable stay I would like to thank Hk team and Abhishak they give good service. This hotel is good location and well mention Hk staff is very helpful.

reviews.author: Shailaja SS
reviews.title: Beautiful Location
reviews.text: The only good thing about this property is its location. Rooms are just good. Food very average. They seem to have a very crazy system when tourists come in vehicles hired from Srinagar, they do not permit either the vehicle be parked at the hotel or the driver to stay there. The staff at the restaurant speak extremely loud. The only saving grace was a staff by the name of Shaukat at the restaurant who was very polite and did his job well.

reviews.author: This.and.That
reviews.title: Breathtaking property in dire need of overhauling their service
reviews.text:
The property is straight out of the gorgeous ad in the Conde' Nast magazine. The hospitality in terms of the warmth with which the staff interacts with you is also world- class. But that's also the probelm area- when one pays for a luxury vacation one does not anticipate calling up the helpdesk for fixing the basics like room heating, bedding etc.
Even though every call was met with promptness, we got tired of calling for essentials by the end!
And the biggest let down is not being allowed to order beverages, (let alone liquor) at their gorgeous poolside.

reviews.author: Siddhant R
reviews.title: Amazing property at Gulmarg
reviews.text:
We visited this property during winters when there was a snowfall. I would recommend to visit this property only during winters, has some breathtaking views especially from  Himalayan view room. Though this property do has some 'cons' as well:

Cons-
1. Free internet which hotel provide is like 2G speed internet. Its very slow in this 4G world. Although they do have option to upgrade the internet speed but you have to burn your pocket for that.
2. Hotel staff is uninformative. I would say not all but some staff is.
3. This is completely dry hotel. So make sure you carry alcohol along with you. Hotel does provide you space to sit for free but with chargeable sheesha service and snacks.
4. Though hotel location is fantastic and is near to everything you want to do in Gulmarg but still last 100m to reach hotel is like you are climbing a mountain. So whenever you want to go to hotel after completing any outdoor activity, you have to literally climb last 100m. (If you r willing to spend then private taxi can drop you to the hotel. They will charge Rs 200 for to drop literally for 15 seconds only)

And some Pros-
1. Food. Hotel serves you very delicious food. One of the best I have ever had in any hotel
2.  Interior. Almost entire hotel has wooden interior decoration which was quite a relief especially during winters. 
3. Recreation room, Swimming pool and Gym - They will charge you for swimming costume but the location where swimming pool is quite amazing. In winter its hot water swimming pool
4. Hotel itself - Its best in Gulmarg. So if you want to spend money put into this one.

In the end, hotel does provide airport pick-up and drop service from Srinagar. But its on a chargeable basis.

On the whole, we enjoyed our stay in Khyber and will recommend to everyone despite some cons in this property.

reviews.author: NeerajVarandani
reviews.title: Anniversary Visit worth all pennies but...
reviews.text:
It happened to be a place well decided for our anniversary. I along with my wife reached Out to Khyber - gulmarg on our fifth day of the trip. First four days we spent in Sri nagar - exploring different places. Well this hotel was more than we expected. 
Pros
Next to gondolla 
Very good food, chef prepares good dishes and have planned menu very nicely
Courteous, helping and supporting staff. They stretch to make your stay comfortable 
Temperature controlled
Spa - in house, amazing services
Swimming pool : temp control, though at the corner of the premises, after the spa

Cons
We stayed in basic room, at night we felt sort of oxygen in room 

We enjoyed each day of our two nights stay in April'17. 
One could still see the snow here and there, melting and the water droplets falling ... the moment you check in to the place to the check out, the process was smooth. I am glad that the hotel staff helped when my wifes' health deteriorated to the extent that they delivered our anniversary cake in the middle of the night - as requested by me.

I have only good words for this place,if you can afford them a must stay place for atleast two nights

reviews.author: Vandana G
reviews.title: Much hyped property for the price
reviews.text: We stayed for 1 night at this beautiful hotel Khyber in Gulmarg. I believe this is the only five star and highly recommended property by everyone. The hotel was good, excellent services but definitely not worth the price. Maybe during peak season and a bit of a last minute booking we got a slightly high rate of almost 23K for the night, which seemed high and not really worth the property. There was nothing so extra special about the place which I could really go back and talk about, rather I felt it is over hyped. There was an indoor pool though for kids and a small activity play room to keep them busy. Staff is helpful, services and food was good.  Overall a nice experience.

reviews.author: Aastha K
reviews.title: Snowy holiday
reviews.text: A place where one gets stunned to see so much beauty. The hotel is the best thing about gulmarg. Food, pool, the ambience, the rooms there is just nothing wrong about this place. You name it and you have it. The staff is so so so brilliant. Never ever seen such courteous people. I would have given 5/5 but we were disappointed with the packed breakfast. We were 8 people and were provided only 5 food packs as we had to leave at 5am due to unrest in the valley. But those packs were pathetic. The sandwiches in that were stale and every food pack didnt even have all things. Would be nice if this doesnt happen with any other guest.

reviews.author: Siddhartha Sharma
reviews.title: Relaxed with Pir Panjal Range
reviews.text:
Great Resort. Wooden Structure

Try Himalayan view Rooms.

Wonderful Restaurant team Led by Mr. Shyam

Restaurant Manager Mr. Abid was very professional, caring and helpful. His team of Amit Junaid Sandeep were spontaneous and proactive

House keeping is little slow. And food is very expensive . Quality of food should we improved as we had little bad stomach last afternoon.

If you want to gain peace of mind, stay at Khyber , and rejuvenate yourself with Pir Panjal hills , they are amazing.

reviews.author: KOT K
reviews.title: Almarzooqi
reviews.text: Very nice resort Hotel friendly and helpful staff the reception manager is very helpful and kind person cascading his good behavior to his staff the only problem in this area is the communication services specially the international most of are banned due to political reasons the area is one of the exiting sky resort area it good for 2 to 3 days I recommend it for families and it is better to plan your trip with a tour guid for translation and to manage your requirements for ski bookings

reviews.author: Shalini S
reviews.title: Awesome view
reviews.text:
Located on top of a hill, the hotel commands an awesome view of snow clad mountains and vast valley. As we visited in April, the valley was covered in snow....One can sit on the terrace and feel peace descend on you.
The Hotel is luxurious with an old world charm. It's popularity makes it difficult to get a booking. However it's remote location makes it cumbersome to go back and forth...One has to arrange transport to nip into the town. Consequently, it gets crowded in the evenings as all the guests return from their excursions and are reluctant to go out again.
It's coffee shop has an excellent view of the mountains but it's menu leaves much to be desired. There could be more variety....
Their spa is just awesome...

reviews.author: deepalidas2015
reviews.title: Best place to dine in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel with authentic interiors.
Went for lunch.
Ordered the Khyber Tarami which is a Kashmiri set meal comprising of the following-

Tabakmaaz-Chewy and tasteless.
Seekh Kebab-Well made but not excellent.
Rista-Huge kofta in a red gravy.
Mirchwangan Korma-Well made lamb curry.
Gustaba-Huge kofta in yakhni gravy.
Tamatar Tsaman-Paneer in tomato gravy.
Haaq-Kashmiri leafy vegetable.
(Both Koftas have room for improvement)
Rice.
Though we preferred to eat it with Naans.(Not part of the set meal).
Price Rs 1600/-More than enough for 2.
The set meal is not outstanding but good and a good value for money in a 5 star setting.
The service is impersonal and a tad condescending.
The GM was very courteous though.

reviews.author: VHymakar
reviews.title: Great Hotel, Location and Service
reviews.text:
We have been picked up from the Airport, the welcome party was courteous and helpful, Our check in process  was very smooth, rooms were superb, view from the room was awesome. Gym , swimming pool and other infra is amazing.

Two things they could look at improving :

1) Spa therapists seem to be still under training, but to give benefit of doubt having a spa in Gulmarg itself is something great.

2) Noise from the rooms can be heard in the corridor.

3) Balcony and bathroom glass are see through so we could see what people were doing in their rooms if they had their curtains open for a view. This is a big downside.

2) Quality of food definitely needs improvement - we found pasta very salty, paneer burnt on edges etc., Deserts and breakfast were great.

reviews.author: Anshul Kumar
reviews.title: Good property
reviews.text:
Stayed there for 2 nights...the hotel ambience and rooms are very good. Location is great - overlooking the mountains and very close to the gondola.

Staff was very courteous and helpful

Food is average...limited options for breakfast...Kashmiri cuisine is definitely below par

Wifi reception in the room was a problem

reviews.author: karansingh
reviews.title: Luxurious resort,beautiful location
reviews.text:
My advice to anyone visiting Gulmarg is to stay in this hotel The views from the room, from the pool, and from the breakfast area is superb.
This resort would make your trip to heavenly Gulmarg complete.An unparalleled location, extremely friendly staff, comfortable rooms and astounding views make this one of the outstanding hotels of this country.A must-visit place and a must-visit hotel.

reviews.author: Abhishek S
reviews.title: "OLD WORLD CHARM"
reviews.text:
Had an amazing experience during my stay, beautiful architecture serene ambience and out of the world views from the room/ balcony.
Initially had a little difficulty during the check-in process but one of the staff, ASRAR took the initiative and smoothened the process, not only was he helpful during the check-in process but also enquired regularly about our needs and always tried his best to help us. My sincere thanks to him.

reviews.author: oskyoscar
reviews.title: swiss experience in India
reviews.text: The Khyber is truly one of the most amazing properties, had a luxury room with the himalayan view. Loads of snow all around and the Hotel is walking distance to the Gondola rides. The heated swimming pool has a super view and the Spa is one of the best in India. The Khyber does lack a choice of restaurants and has one single restaurant that serves all three meals. The Khyber has no comparison in Gulmarg and is simply the most premium property in Gulmarg.  The rooms are not soundproof though and noisy neighbours could be annoying.

reviews.author: Abhishek O
reviews.title: Great Stay and hospitality!!
reviews.text:
we were given a very warm welcome with a cup of khawa ( kashmiri tea ) by the hotel Executive Mr Asrar. He took care of most needs during our stay . Everytime we got back to the reception arae we were asked by Mr Asrar if we were comfortable and enjoying our  stay. They even surprised us by placing a cake in our room when we returned post dinner as he saw that we were a newly married couple. 

i recommend a saty or if one cant get a stay they should atleast go for a meal to the restaurant to enjoy authentic kashmiri cusine.

Asrar is an asset to the resort and is doing an exceptional job of taking care of the guests needs with a smile always.

reviews.author: Ayushiparikh
reviews.title: Nice hotel ,good food
reviews.text:
We were suggested by a few people that khyber is a must go while in gulmarg. Since we were in gulmarg just for a day trip we planned to have lunch at khyber.
We got pretty late by the time we reached khyber for lunch but they agreed to serve us lunch. That was really nice of them
The views from the hotel restaurant and coffee shop were beautiful! All snow covered ! Must visit!

reviews.author: shimauli
reviews.title: Holiday with the kids
reviews.text:
Gulmarg is beautiful and a must must visit. Khyber is a great hotel, conveniently located. We went when it was freezing end February 2017 but the hotel is centrally heated so it wAs fine. 

The Khyber swimming pool is fabulous and the kahwa kept me warm enough :) they don't serve any liquor in the hotel so make sure you bring your own, you won't get any shops in Gulmarg for liquor! 

Rooms are nice and cozy, bkfast is elaborate, we took our girls along 5years and 5 mnths old. Both loved it! 

Staff was friendly and courteous ! And they have the fastest room service across hotels in india that Weve visited :) 

It was snowing, and we did snow biking sledging and skiing took the gondola to 1st stage it worked out great . We had A good guide and taxi guys were great too! 

Make sure you spend enough nights if you want to learn skiing:) 

All in all great experience ! Good value for money and wasn't so crowded when we went always a good thing 😀

Happy holidays 🙏🙏

reviews.author: Travel With Dee

reviews.text: We were visiting Gulmarg for the first time and couldnt have thought of a better place than Khyber! The rooms, the spa and the pool - these 3 are enough to make your decision! Service is fantastic, very friendly staff!  The food was good, however french fries could be a bit better (Since thats one of the things you want to binge eat on) breakfast spread is good too.. reviews.author: 165ankurp
reviews.title: Very Good but can be Great
reviews.text:
I visit Khyber from Feb 9 to 12 2017. It was covered in Snow and was the most beautiful place i ever saw. A beautiful resort of Luxury covered under Snow. The view outside the pool and the room was just awesome. Gulmarg is known for Skiing and February was the perfect time for it. We learnt a little bit and had good fun. The resort as such is the best resort in Gulmarg the only one with all luxuries. Its centrally heated which is a must and then it has its Heated Pool, Jacuzzi, Steam and what not and all this is part of the money you pay for the room. So yes you could be under3 meters of snow and still enjoy all the luxuries on earth. The hospitality was at its best - A special thanks to Mr. Asrar or Azrar who took great care of us . They have split beds in room which i think should be changed for couple rooms plus the noise from neighbouring room TV does come into your room so they should look into it. Since your in a 5 star you would expect everything to be perfect and thus the 1 star goes off here. The food is indeed simply awesome except for Pasta's. Try their Indian food and you will be Amazed specially the Dum Biryani's. 

Overall its a great place nestled under Snow - i wonder how did they manage this kind of luxury so high and under snow. My recommendation if you don;t want to ski then don;t stay beyond 2-3 days . You could surely use all facilities at the resort.

reviews.author: genghis_on_road
reviews.title: Great hotel, kids' facilities were disappointing
reviews.text:
Stayed for 4 days with my wife and 2 kids (3 and 7 years).

What we liked -
Great property. really grand looking.
Service was fantastic. Very prompt and courteous staff. I think the service was the highlight of our stay.
Rooms were fabulous.
Amenities like the heated pool, jacuzzi and the sauna were well maintained and were great fun for the kids. the gym looked nice though we did not use it.
The food buffet had a lot of variety.

What we did not like -
Considering that most guests were families with children, there was surprisingly little to keep kids engaged. 
The kids play area was icy cold and dark and gloomy. There were no attendants so you could not leave the kids. Very few games. Basically you would not want to spend time there at all.
There was no kids menu - ala carte or buffet. It would have been good to have at least a couple of items on the menu or in the buffet that were specifically for kids.
Other than this, they had a peculiar rule of not allowing the locals into the hotel. So my guide and I had to stand outside in sub zero temperatures to plan our next day or any such conversation. Apart from the cold, it was just very distasteful.
And, the food is expensive. I must also add food is expensive everywhere in Gulmarg for obvious reasons. We had breakfast and dinner included in our plan. But when we did spend, meals were about 5000 for the family. Even if you ask for plain boiled pasta for the kid, it was charged at Rs. 900. At the Taj, they would give it to us for free, considering we were spending 4k on the rest of the meal anyway.

Overall, I think its a great hotel with a wonderful staff. I hope they focus on the little guests a bit more.

reviews.author: NoinahJaeb
reviews.title: The Best in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Mesmerizing views from the room, from the pool and from the breakfast area. Topping it up with great service & high security, what more can one ask for in Gulmarg?

The hotel was just a short (but a steep slope) walk away from the Gondola station; making that an easy access.

There were flights of stairs at different parts of the hotel (at main entrance, to the room, to the pool & to the kids play room) so not sure if there any lift access (did not notice).

reviews.author: rajiv7679
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort at Nice Location
reviews.text:
It was my first visit to Gulmarg and I would say that words are less to write about Gulmarg. We stayed at the Khyber. The place is built at great location, it is at walking distance from gondola. The resort is built with heritage theme taking into consideration the culture of Kashmir. 
The rooms and facilities are fine. There are not many options for food in the resort. As the resort is comparatively new, it needs proper maintenance and up gradation time to time. There is a difference between very good and great and Khyber needs to cover that distance through its hospitality & warmth. Overall it was nice experience as I feel the USP of Khyber is its location, it's snow all around. Do visit it to feel and experience Enchanting Gulmarg!

reviews.author: BlueWinchester
reviews.title: Royal Stay
reviews.text: We stayed here for 3 nights and we had a great time. The Hotel has a beautiful wooden architecture,  perfect for honeymooners like us.  They have a very good breakfast spread. We opted for Ala carte for dinner and that was also good. Only one con i would say is wifi here is chargeable unlike Taj Vivanta Srinagar so four stars for that.

reviews.author: MManish
reviews.title: Great weather, great property!
reviews.text: We had taken the 2 b/r suite. I must say it was huge. A Duplex suite opens to the garden.  Huge toilets. Luxury quality. Amazing speed in room service. I must say. Great spread of breakfast, dinner. Nice shisha place! Great outdoor space to sit and enjoy walks, just sit and chill. Swimming pool was under maintenance during our 3 day stay. The spa was also commendable!

reviews.author: Ashwani G
reviews.title: Luxurious!!
reviews.text: We visited this beautiful property in December along with our friends. The property is made very well with all amenities you would want. The checkin was swift and we were allocated rooms close to each other. The hotel was full but it did not feel like that. The restaurant as well as other services were good. We had food in their main restaurant which was of good quality. The highlight was their temperature controlled swimming pool area which had lovely views of the mountains, trees & snow. Would recommend staying here if you are visiting Gulmarg.

reviews.author: rahjal1
reviews.title: Amazing Property
reviews.text: We had a lovely stay at this property in may, 2016, we were a couple with two children aged 11 each.The hotel is fabulous with sweeping views and well maintained. A stay here is highly recommended for a maximum of two days. The options for the children are a bit limited and the games room being unsupervised can get a bit messy. The Buffet is excellent but gets a repetitive after a while. The spa is top notch and highly recommended.The Staff is ever smiling and helpful. Room service is prompt and swift. Overall a thoroughly enjoyable trip!

reviews.author: anish1710
reviews.title: Great experience! Must visit in winters
reviews.text: I stayed at this property for 2 nights with my wife.I would like to thanks the reservation team (Mr. Irfan) for allowing us to defer our booking at no extra cost, even when our initial booking was non-refundable. It is an hour drive from Srinagar airport. Make sure you carry hard copy of your reservation confirmation as you have to show it at the check post. Check in was smooth, welcome kava drink was a nice touch. Rooms and property have that typical hill station look. The heated pool was nice. There is  jacuzzi and steam facility in locker rooms. It might be just the timing, the property was really full with mostly extended groups with kids. Breakfast & dinner buffet was limited and decent. I would recommend ala-carte options as the preparation was much better. There is a waiting to get seated in the restaurant, so make sure you plan accordingly. No hotels/restaurants in Gulmarg serve alcohol so make sure to carry some with you from Srinagar. Hotel does lack a good concierge who could help you would bookings. Wi-fi is paid. Over all a good experience., would love to come back in winters with snow all around.

reviews.author: MarciaA1973
reviews.title: Suíça na India
reviews.text: Este é o melhor hotel da região. Fica muito próximo ao centro, de onde sai a Gondola que leva as pistas de ski. Os quartos eram amplos e tinham vista para o patio interno e as montanhas nevadas ao fundo. Não havia muitas opções de divertimento, além da piscina, academia e spa.

reviews.author: Anang_11
reviews.title: Over Hyped - Over Rated - Over Priced
reviews.text:
We were in Khyber for 2 nights stay. We booked this hotel almost four months before. When I entered my credit card details, entire amount was charged immediately, without asking for pin., which was surprising. 

Any how when we reached hotel, we showed our online booking receipt. Staff agreed that booking was confirmed but were not sure that payment had been made. Room allotted to us was premium and having himalayan view. Rooms were specious, clean, well appointed. There was open gallery with sit out, facing snow caped mountains. Bed was large and comfortable.
