Wash rooms were clean and well designed. But room was not properly ventilated. We had to keep balcony doors open to avoid suffocation. But after some time found room too cold in side and had to close doors. No proper room temperatures were maintained. We called then in the midnight to set A/C temperatures but were advised to keep gallery doors open.

Location of Khyber is a great advantage. (walking distance from Gandola Ride, the main attraction in Gulmarg). View from Rooms, Restaurants and from all over hotel are beautiful. Entire property of the Hotel is Decent and well maintained. Right from Entrance to Rooms, Spa, Pool , every thing gives a feeling of Five Star Hotel.

But when it comes to service and hospitality, it is no way near Five Star Category. The Rates we pay for Rooms are too high as compared to service, warmth and hospitality to be rated as Five Star. It lacks the feeling of luxurious treatment. Staff is required to be trained properly. 

When you are charging so huge rates for rooms you are supposed to provide basic amenities and facilities. No Free WiFi. No proper Travel desk to provide full information and assistance for Gandola Ride. Though Hotel is a walking distance from Gandola, approach road is on a steep slope. Difficult to walk. But no complimentary dropping and pick up facility. Restaurant is too small, considering number of rooms in Hotel. No Multiple restaurants and dining options available. Room service was pathetic. Telephoned to then several times to remove dishes after lunch but nobody turned. We ourselves removed it and kept it outside and it was lying there for hours. But no one bothered to remove it. Restaurant is overpriced and above that room service rates are further 30 % higher. No Chinese food available. At the time of check in we were told to book restaurant first for dining. When we telephoned to book a seat, we were told that restaurant is full and we had to go there and wait for a seat to sit. and this happened every time. 

In all it was a mixed feeling for us. Too costly Five Star property, which lacks five star hospitality. Awesome location, great views, Good Rooms but at the end of the day no luxurious feeling. 

I will not visit again and will find better option next time.

reviews.author: priti q
reviews.title: Khyber in Gulmarg
reviews.text: The Khyber is a strange alpine chalet that has evolved into a multilevel wood and stone series of buildings. It is close to the Gondola/ ski lift terminus so if you are a skier its a great location. The rooms were well appointed as were the bathrooms. The buffet was a strange mixture of Indian, Chinese with a pasta dish thrown in to make it continental. The tea shop in the lobby sells Kashmiri Kawa to die for and scones that are like flat biscuits. Very tasty indeed.

reviews.author: Vinod D
reviews.title: Luxurious!!!
reviews.text: Stayed here in may2016 for 3days.....very beautiful place to enjoy the scenic gulmarg....comfortable rooms...great food....a bit expensive though....very close to all the tourist spots in gulmarg....overall a premium place to stay.

reviews.author: RamNit1996
reviews.title: Great location but not so great restaurant service
reviews.text: The biggest plus is the location and views. It is walking distance from the Gandola and hence you are very close to the biggest attraction of Gulmarg. Most locations of the hotel have a great view and many picture spots for families. The restaurant is really overpriced compared to the presentation and taste. Since there are not many restaurant options in Gulmarg you have to put up. Good place for one night stay but not more.

reviews.author: Yash1977
reviews.title: Beautiful views
reviews.text:
A stunning property. Great location. Beautiful rooms and views of the majestic Himalayas. Very luxurious interiors in our room. They also have a warm swimming pool and gym overlooking the mountains. Location also close to the gondola ride. Walking distance in fact. 

They don't serve alcohol but are fine with people carrying their own alcohol and consuming it in a nice room off the main lobby. 

They only flip side was the quality of the playing area for young children or toddlers. They could have invested a little more in getting better slides and swings for children. Additionally they have a play room which has a few screens, games (table tennis, carrom etc) and toys etc but given their location where they have heavy snow or rain this room needs to be focussed on a little more. Maybe some slides and other items for toddlers.  Additionally this room needs to be supervised as a lot of games and toys were in poor shape/broken. 

Food is excellent at their all day dining area.

reviews.author: shar2210
reviews.title: Location location location!!
reviews.text:
Excellent hotel with amazing views.Its the place to stay in Gulmarg.
Easy walk to the ski lift and the cable car.
Its an uber luxurious place with a fantastic spa and pool
Well maintained well trained staff adn great food.
A winner all the way

reviews.author: MenonRajeev
reviews.title: Great Place to stay
reviews.text: Stayed at the Khyber for 4 nights. Since this was our first trip to Kashmir, the expectations were very high and we were not disappointed.  The rooms were quite spacious to accommodate a family of 4 (extra bed included).  The view from the room was simply amazing.  The indoor heated swimming pool was definitely a hit with the kids.  The best part of the hotel is its location.  Buffet is expensive for the spread that they have.  Staff were courteous and helpful and we enjoyed our stay at Gulmarg.

reviews.author: ruchika thakur
reviews.title: Haven in the mountains
reviews.text:
Nestled in the deep woods , the Khyber is located at the foot hills of the snow clad mountains . It gives you the illusion of actually being in the midst of snow and the perfect central heating allows you the best of both worlds- the comfort of waking up to the snow enveloped in the warmth of your room. 

The majestic entrance has kept the Kashmiri architecture in mind and the extensive use of wood adds a warm glow to the property. 
The rooms are spacious nd the balconies offer outstanding views . The sunk in bath tub overlooking the woods is the highlight of the room . 

The restaurant has a decent buffet , but the Wazwan was not upto the mark . The tabak Maas was dry and rubbery , the gravies were too thick and oily . The Haaq saag was excellent though . For us , the best was the trout which we ordered for starters . 
The kids had white sauce pasta which was excellent . The hotel does not serve alcohol , though they do allow you to have your own in the Hooka bar /-without corkage charges. 
The service was good 

It is located close to the  Gondolas .

reviews.author: Rumanaachwa
reviews.title: Excellent !!
reviews.text:
I stayed here for 2 nights with my husband. It's the best property at Gulmarg. It's very clean, comfortable and truly luxurious. The rooms and bathrooms are very well equipped and spacious. The staff is very polite, friendly and efficient . They have an excellent in house doctor, who lives on the property itself and his services are complimentary from the hotel. My husband fell ill during our stay from a kidney stone , and the doctor was extremely efficient not only in his diagnosis but also in his treatment, because of which our trip wasn't cut short in any way. Their premier indulgence room has breath taking views of the mountains in the distance and it was particularly magical during our stay because it had begun to snow. 
But on the downside, the food at the Kyber is terrible. We ordered a chicken quiche, from their pastry and savoury counter, and it was inedible. Even the food in their restaurant was poor. The mutton biryani , we ordered was more like mutton curry mixed with rice, while the quality of their buffet was way below par and shockingly over priced. All in all, Kyber is a wonderful luxurious resort and definitely worth a stay. But until they do not improve the quality of their food, you're better off eating else where.

reviews.author: holiday_lovers2011
reviews.title: Elegant place to stay at high price tag
reviews.text:
Paid for two night but stayed only fro 1 night due to personal reason. Excellent stay. Upon informing at desk reg our one night cut short, hotel op. manager was bit concerned thinkign that we are leaving due to hotel issue. We clarified that nothing like that and its unfortunate that we will not stay for 2 night. As per policy they couldn't refund for night which we didn't stay but made our lunch, dinner and internet free. Nice to see that atleast Hotel cares for their guest and willing to take that extra step to give comfort to their guests. Done relaxing SPA and is highly recommended.
Room we got was nice spacious room. Hotel is offering 4 start facility and very popular. 
However this come at very high price tag. Need to pay INR 200 for 30 min next access.
Breakfast opens at 8.00am which is bit late, sp when tourist rush for Gondola tkt in early morning.
Overall very satisfied and highly recommended.

reviews.author: RSB54
reviews.title: Super Resort and beautiful location
reviews.text:
It lives up to its reputation of being an excellent property ! The staff is also very courteous and helpful. Its professionally managed and we had a very good experience.
There was a minor issue of leakage in the bathroom which was efficiently sorted out.

reviews.author: Shweta M
reviews.title: Pricey but no option
reviews.text:
A lot of the glitter of Gulmarg rubs off on The Khyber, and even though you've paid a bomb and received sub-par service (especially for those used to Taj standards), you come back feeling - Where else, in this snowy wonderland.

First a disclaimer - mountains are difficult to live in, basic amenities like water and hot food are difficult to come by, so giving 5 star amenities & service is commendable.

The Non-so-great parts : The grounds are not very expansive, there is a small courtyard and the rooms on the outside look onto the wired fence - not a bad view when everything is covered in snow. The food is decent but no authentic Kashmiri flavours in the breakfast or dinner spreads. There is a kids' play area but it's not well stocked and either are there any caretakers arounds. The corridors get drafts of cold air so be careful while walking down from the spa or pool. 

The Bad - the service is slow and patchy. 

The Awesome - The heated pool and spa area is amazing. A great way to relax sore muscles post skiing or playing in the snow. The glassed pool looks onto the snow & is almost magical. The lobby has little niches with a Kashmiri touch - carpets, carvings etc which are lovely and great for kids to be contained.

The Practical - The Khyber doesn't serve alcohol, but allows you to carry your own in their hookah bar, so do stock up in Srinagar.

reviews.author: abs34
reviews.title: True 5 * resort
reviews.text: Had visited as part of company Conference on 2014  August , Truly found a Royal Resort with excellent view . Only Downside  was the food which is letting down the resort  but overall a Royal resort . Would visit again

reviews.author: Reviews-by-MT
reviews.title: Nice hotel but Sadly did not enjoy Gulmarg
reviews.text:
We stayed two nights at the hotel. It is actually one of the best hotels in the region. We enjoyed the warm welcome drink of Kawah in the cold weather. The Kawah is made up safron and almonds with cardamon and makes it a refreshing warm drink. 

We were allocated a room on 1st floor with a side view of the snow caped mountains. It was OK room. We were ugraded the room to a better room the next day . one of the drawbacks of the hotel was the actual contruction and layout . There are no lifts and the stair case and the coridors are very badly lit. 

The restaurant was OK and the food was not bad. The staff did actually see through to our special diet and needs. 

They have a nice indoor swiming pool with see through glassed walls where you can enjoy a good scenery whilst swimming. There pool is not managed too well. The local guests do actually behave so badly and are notoriously loud without giving any consideration the other guests. Sadly the Jacuzi and Sauna were out of use and were being renovated at that time.  

The Management of the hotel could however be improved. There was no proper guidance or information from the hotel about the sight seeing or about the operation of Gondolas and Guides . The hotel should organise the tours and tickets to the Gondalas and provide the excursion or at least have a fixed price policy controlling the touts /local guides who are such a menace, just there to loot you. 

We were set to go to the mountains on the Gondolas and a short ride of 500 metres from the hotel to the Gondola base cost us 500 rupees and the guide charged us 1200 rupees just to be with on teh Gondola . It was really not worth the trip to Gulmarg. The people of Gulmarg all appeared notorious and untrustworthy - just there to loot you. There is no management whatsoever by the Government . The place is litered despite the natural beautiful surrounding . 

The Gondola Management is also the worst one could expect. No system at all and there is no consideration given to the weak , old or people with small kids. Absolute chaos. 

When on the hills, the sledge touts are after you and are very forceful. Serious accidents can happen as the snow is turned into ice and is very slippery . We saw old people fall and yet there were many who were extremely cold and just wanted to get down the hills but yet could not get onto the gondolas because of the unmanaged crowds. 

Being the best hotel in the area , the managment should at least see to their guest comfortable stay.  The hotel is undoubtedly over hyped and over rated and the rates are unreasonably high. 

Despite the natural beauty of Gulmarg, I would not return back , firstly due to the people there and secondly because it is not maintained  and managed properly.

reviews.author: panks_41086
reviews.title: snowy resort
reviews.text: This the best resort in Gulmarg. We stayed there for 3 nights during winter. When we reached there was snow fall going on so It was fully covered with fresh snow & looking very beautiful. Very good ambiance with very good feeling. Staff was very courteous & helpful. Rooms were also good & spacious. Food was also good. Specially the Kehwa served here was very good.

reviews.author: pawanlakhotia
reviews.title: Very nice location
reviews.text: The hotel is very nicely located in the centre of Gulmarg very close to Gandola may not be more than 300 mtrs. The food  in the restaurant was good but hotel rooms were just OK compared to its very high price.

reviews.author: Gautam73
reviews.title: Fabulous hotel
reviews.text: We visited the Khyber in Feb 2016 and loved it. It was our first visit to Gulmarg and it turned it out to be amazing. Everything from the rooms, the food and the service were very good. The property is very well located and with very easy access to the ski slopes. I would definitely recommend this hotel to anybody planning to go.

reviews.author: Nitin A
reviews.title: Luxury
reviews.text:
Very good and luxurious hotel. The moment we stepped in the lobby, we were impressed with the lavishness of hotel. The hotel was very good!! Spa/ jacuzziwas very good! 
Service was exceptionally quick. Very impressed on that part. But not at the restaurant, where it was slow. 
Some lackings though - 
the kids play area was hardly anything.... The kind of hotel that Khyber is - a much better play area was expected!!
Restaurant - Kashmiri food served was not authentic, the service not very prompt. The staff at restaurant seemed to be bit unwelcoming kinds as compared to the staff at any other area of hotel. 
The concierge was hardly of any help to plan day trips!! 
But all these shortcomings were overlooked by the beauty of gulmarg and the hotel itself. Having a dip in warm pool, with views of snow all around was a heavenly experience. 
Definitely an expensive property, but then it's a lavish one!!
If it fits in budget, don't look anywhere else in gulmarg!!

reviews.author: Bhavna2016
reviews.title: Warm hospitality, tasty food, and a lovely pool !
reviews.text: Nice hotel with simple tasty food and warm service from all staff especially Ishfaq who made a special effort to make sure we were well looked after. Chef veer organised a delicious dinner for us for a special occassion. All our demands were happily met by Basharat and Jerin whether it was F and B or housekeeping. Memorable trip in all thanks to the staff at khyber. The pool and spa were lovely and heated perfectly to make you forget the cold outside!

reviews.author: parsvakumar
reviews.title: Khyber , Gulmarg
reviews.text: Nice hotel , Brilliant ambience ,good facility for the children to play indoors, nice spa and heated indoor swimming pool ,useful in all seasons. Sad part is limited food variety , only one restaurant . Very nice facility to keep your extra clothes and footwear for snow in the security area without having to carry it to your room .

reviews.author: ShehreyaarDar
reviews.title: Stupendofabulious!!!
reviews.text: Awsome place & amazingly built up. Infra is outstanding & so is F&B. Need a place to relax & chil;, try Khyber. Spcl thnx To Ishfaq Shah for amazing Service. CLose in the lap of nature. Seee ya soon Khyber.

reviews.author: sidsaraf
reviews.title: heaven on earth
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at the khyber between 17th to 20th feb 2016,
we were a group of 22 people and i have to admit the property and the staff was simply excellent. 
Great hotel and location, excellent spa, superb gym and indoor pool.
A note to the management that i asked for my mattress to be flipped or changed room 4007 as it was too too soft to get any sleep on specially post a day of intense skiing, this was a huge disappointment
the hotel ski gear deposit room next to the main porch is simply a great idea very convenient and well thought of,
we would usually spend our early evenings post skiing at their coffee shop overlooking the grounds, the scones and coffee was great   
But apart from that this was a really great hotel, a special thanks to ASIF who was specially sent to sri nagar airport on behalf of the management for our group to check in at the airport,
But due to a snow slide most of us  missed our flight, 
I managed to reach the airport and without his help it would have been impossible to catch the flight, he was extra helpful polite and very responsible, kudos to the management and the team to extend and offer services beyond their resort

reviews.author: PriyaSuri
reviews.title: Brilliant Hotel
reviews.text: From the minute we entered the hotel, everything was seamless. The check-in process was quick and they had upgraded us to Luxury Balcony room. That was a big room. They view from the room & bathroom was stunning. The indoor pool was very nice. Didn't have the time to check out spa. Food was average and a bit over-priced. It's very well located next to the ski entrance. I felt a 2 night stay was short and would definitely like to go back again.

reviews.author: Highlandtrekker
reviews.title: Excellent location
reviews.text: Stayed in the hotel for two days . It has an excellent location . It's a beautiful property and have lovely interiors . The whole of Gulmarg was covered with snow at that time. The food is ok , bfast is a good spread but the restaurant is expensive . They have a good spa . The reception teams needs to be pushed a bit . They are slow to respond and don't have ready answers .

reviews.author: Gautam_Meetu
reviews.title: A 5 Star property in Gulmarg
reviews.text: It's a wonderful 5 star hotel at 9000 Ft above sea level, with lounges, a huge dining hall, coffee lounges, all wth huge windows and facing the hills / forests. It has a fanstatic Spa and a heated swimming pool looking out in the lawns, which were covered with snow when we visited. Typical chain hotel, with all modern amenities and conforts. The only draw back, was that it does not have views of the Gulmarg Valley. But overall great experience of playing in the snow in the lawns and coming back to the comforts of a star hotel.

reviews.author: Brijacob16
reviews.title: Worth the wait
reviews.text:
The wife and I have been planning a holiday here for a while. Their unavailability speaks of their popularity. Finally we managed to make it for our anniversary and boy were we glad we did.
The ambience, location, rooms, staff is all 5 star. It's warm (thanks to the central heating) friendly and homely. The spa is a must visit and so too is the heated pool.
Hat tip to Sujit, the GM who you will find all smiles, warm and welcoming at the lobby taking care and listening to everyone on everything.

However the only thing that needs drastic improvement is the food. The restaurant and the food is just passable. Breakfast is strictly nice but that's about it. 
Would recommend heading to (by car) Highlands Park for a meal and you will know what I mean.
Hence only a 4 Star rating :)

reviews.author: Anuradha257
reviews.title: Heavenly abode in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
The wood finished hotel is in stark contrast to the cold of January in Gulmarg. The warmth of the decor is welcoming on stepping inside after the chilly wind. The attention paid to  view of the snow clad environs from the lobby, dining area and swimming pool is praiseworthy. The pool is one of its kind with glass walls on three sides showing only snow-clad Gulmarg as far as one can see. The artefacts and photos all round the hotel were beautiful.
I had a Deluxe room which could have had a better view from its glass wall if facing the opposite side but they were full when requested.
The services are very good. Pool comes with jacuzzi, steam & sauna. The L'Occitane spa is one of the few in India with very good ambience. We tried the Relaxing and Deep tissue massage, both very good. Staff is courteous and helpful.
Breakfast was good. Dinner could have been much better for such a nice hotel.

reviews.author: Prachi513
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with the best possible view!
reviews.text:
Khyber is a luxurious resort located walking distance from the Gulmarg Gondola. The best part about this resort is the view from everywhere on the property. Both Gulmarg view and Himalayan view rooms are equally good. It was a memorable experience to watch the moon-lit silver mountains from the balcony of our room. The bathrooms are just perfect. Loved the spa and the heated swimming pool. The breakfast spread is good too. 
The heating in the room needs to be constantly adjusted to arrive at a comfortable temperature.

reviews.author: rics9999
reviews.title: The Best in Gulmarg
reviews.text: This was my first visit to Kashmir. My stay at Khyber was exceptionally good. I loved the resort. The indoor heated pool, restaurants & other facilities is excellent. The staff extremely polite and very helpful.   The accommodation is nice and very comfortable . Having said all this , it was disappointing that the hotel charged for the wifi which was INR 750 a day.

reviews.author: Vivek Sharma
reviews.title: Worth visiting, food and service can be better
reviews.text:
First up, I am a native of J&K and frankly I felt a lot of pride while staying in this property, that someone from my state had the courage and vision to invest in a property of this grandeur. A big thumbs up to the owners who have created one of the best properties I have ever stayed in. The resort is done beautifully, both on the outside and interiors. In fact, walking through the lobby area and the corridors, you actually get this feeling that someone has indeed built this property with a lot of passion. It is beautiful from both the inside and the outside, and the heated pool with glass walls and a view of snow-clad mountains from the outside is simply breathtaking.
The resort is indeed very expensive but at the end of the experience, you will feel that it is worth the money spent. However, there are three downsides:
1. The food was just okay. I gorge on Kashmiri food but not even a single thing I had could be called mouth watering (and it doesn't feel good when it is also outrageously expensive). Bored with the food, we started eating outside food for lunch and dinners over the next two days
2. Wifi is paid and ridiculously expensive. It will not cost a lot to offer a free Wifi service and on the other hand I'm not sure how much you earn through a paid Wifi service-take that measured call to make customers happier
3. Room service was pathetic-we had to wait for a good 45 minutes to get some basic crockery into our room and had to call up at least 4-5 times to finally get it. At another occasion, we had ordered chinese food and asked for Soy, Chilli and tomato sauce. We just got a bottle of tomato sauce after 30 minutes and the staff member told us that he will get us the rest soon, he never turned up!!
Apart from the minor irritants above which can be taken care of, it was definitely an unforgettable stay. Am likely to come back again.

reviews.author: Hemzzy
reviews.title: Luxury in a winter wonderland
reviews.text: Hotel is very luxurious, rooms and bathrooms included. Kahwa Tea (welcome drink) was a special treat.  Staff and Management were friendly and especially Zaffir Malik who was always at our service. The food was delicious most of all the vegetarian Kashmiri dishes.

reviews.author: Manuj
reviews.title: Luxury at super premium rates !!
reviews.text: I stayed at this hotel in the month of August. Hotel offers unparallel luxury in Gulmarg. I am a vegetarian and faced no issues with finding vegetarian food rather I loved their veg Biryani & Dum aloo kashmiri. Rooms are luxurious and toiletries match the class. All said stay at this hotel when you want to splurge but rest assured view from hotel coffee room is spectacular.

reviews.author: Divs_Kataria
reviews.title: Just beautiful!!!
reviews.text: We visited Khyber in January 2016 for lunch at their restaurant Cloves, the all day dining multi cuisine restaurant. The resort is just beautiful and divine. Lovely architecture inside with hints of Persian -Arabic culture. We had ala carte instead of buffet (which is Rs. 1800 + taxes) per person. We called for mushroom tikka with ulta parantha as starter and for main course we had aloom dum (must have if vegetarian), garlic naan and boondi raita. We ended our meal with scrumptious frozen panacotta with wild berries. Our bill came to around Rs. 2500. If you are in Gulmarg, do visit this place for awesome food and great hospitality. The premises of Khyber looks really great for stay as well with snow all around.

reviews.author: nidhi27
reviews.title: Yeh Haseen Wadiyan at Khyber
reviews.text:
Awesome property...staff was very courteous and helpful. 

Just felt that rooms should have been serviced before guests check in and not attended to when asked for it.

The welcome kahwa tea was the best we have had ... our group was big but the staff ensured we had a comfortable stay and our trip was memorable. 

The heated pool was loved by kids and adults...

reviews.author: aparajita b
reviews.title: Luxurious & Indulgent
reviews.text:
Khyber is the kind of hotel you spoil yourself with. When its completely snowed out outside, you can sit in the centrally heated hotel, with decent food and areas to sit and sip your hot chocolate and watch the snow falling around you.

The rooms are luxurious and well appointed, but have small issues like the heating system, which has a mind of its own, a bathroom floor which floods a little while you're still in the shower, and the shower which is a little tricky to figure out. Nothing that cannot be ignored, when you realise the temperature outside is -12.

The staff is very pleasant, everybody from the guards at the gate (who deserve a medal for standing in that much snow), the serving staff at their restaurant, the reception, captains, house keeping staff, every individual is top notch and a its a pleasure to interact with them.

The food is super expensive, and considering there is no way you can venture out in the snow at dinner time to eat somewhere else, talk to the staff to give you a package deal. The food itself is good, with some stand outs like the mutton raan and the kadhi, though the temperature of the food is a bit of an issue.

reviews.author: Anamika_Butalia
reviews.title: Great hotel, horrible service!
reviews.text:
For my birthday recently, I decided to do a winter holiday in Kashmir with a group of eight comprising family and friends. In Gulmarg, we stayed at The Khyber and were mesmerised by the property—its location, views, property as well as rooms. We stayed for two nights. 

Although we had a really pleasant stay, since the rooms are very comfortable and spacious, the food is good, there were a LOT of negatives!! 

On check-in, the front office desk didn't even take us through the hotel's offerings—the various restaurants, the spa, the pool, etc. In fact, when I enquired about the pool, they mentioned that it was closed due to maintenance and would inform me when it opens up. I didn't hear back from them at all. On my last day, I decided to walk around the property before checkout and much to my dismay found that the pool had been fully-operational during the period of our stay.

The next evening, we ordered some room service and no one showed up with our order. No one even called to express regret at missing the order. It's like they'd forgotten or that we were unheard.

Neither did the housekeeping staff give us proper instructions on using the heating system. So, every few hours, we had to call and ask for someone to come and fix the heating, change temperature, etc. 

When you go to a place like this, you expect exemplary service. Unfortunately, The Khyber fails in this very category. During checkout, the front office desk didn't even ask whether we had a pleasant stay!! For the hospitality industry, this is an offending low! I had to ask to fill up a feedback form to put down our grievances.

reviews.author: Namy10
reviews.title: Best place in Gulmarg...
reviews.text:
We booked 2 rooms in Khyber. We stayed in the month of November.
 
It's a human marvel & architecture at a place at this altitude. The lobby is grand . You are welcomed warmly and the check in procedure is completed at Chaikash with "Kahwa"  as Welcome Drink.
 
We were escorted to the room and explained all the functionality. The rooms are good carpeted and excellent view from the room.

The hotel is just a few minutes walk from the gondola station.

The hotel is beautifully maintained throughout. They have a play are called Igloo which is much needed as there is not much to do after sunset.

The only downside to this magnificent hotel is the F & B services. We were booked on a breakfast and dinner plan. All the days we were there the buffet was a complete letdown. The buffet spread was minimalistic. This was brought to the notice of the duty manager. He tried making up by offering a complimentary starter.

All in all a great place to be when in Gulmarg

reviews.author: Markus R
reviews.title: The best hotel you can get in Gulmarg
reviews.text: Wer nach Gulmarg geht, der weiß, auf was er sich einlässt. Das Khyber ist mit Abstand besser als alle anderen Hotels in Gulmarg, verdient im internationalen Vergleich aber die Sterne nicht wirklich. Das Essen ist gut, der Service auch und die Anlage ist auch schön. In den Details, die jedoch nach westlichen Standards Hotels dieser Klasse ausmachen, fehlt es aber. Aber wie gesagt - nachdem wir auch in anderen Hotels waren würden wir nur noch das Khyber buchen.

reviews.author: swetamodi
reviews.title: Paradise on Earth
reviews.text:
The best property in Gulmarg....amazing views from the Himalaya facing rooms....with a cozy balcony....
Food is excellent...breakfast is a well spread buffet....ala carte menu also is really nice...
Service is good...staff is hospitable and courteous...

though we had a bad experience while checking out...they kept calling from 10.30 to vacate room at 12...we informed them that we will do it by 1...but they kept insisting they were full and needed by 12...then we called them to check if extension was possible and they immediately said rooms are available and we can extend....then what was the hurry to vacate the room for check out? They are stuck up on checking out at 12 without any consideration...

reviews.author: DIPALDESAI
reviews.title: Must visit & enjoy Khyber Gulmerg
reviews.text: It's excellent Property in India Kashmir world Paradise Gulmerg... Khyber its Rooms and Ambiance superb and visit on December snow fall @ Hot Swimming Pool... So, many things for Children and for senior citizensview of rooms are wow...

reviews.author: IndiTales
reviews.title: Classic Luxury in a Classic Destination
reviews.text:
Khyber Gulmarg lets you soak in the old world charm while providing you all that you need for modern living. Their wood dominated architecture to their Chaikash that keeps on serving Kahwas and the views from just about everywhere in the property add to the overall experience of Gulmarg. 

You can sit back and enjoy the views from balconies, get spa treatments in athe most professional way and swim in the heated swimming pool surrounded by snow. 

In the mountains do not expect the service at par with urban counterparts. Staff works slowly and their pace - probably they want you to just sit back and relax. 

The room temperature at night goes very high, invariable waking you up - keep the window open a bit to avoid this.

reviews.author: MadhukarSinghania
reviews.title: GREAT HOSPITALITY STANDARD
reviews.text:
I must appreciate the hospitality of the Mr. Sujith Herbert (GM) who took great care to make our stay a memorable one. His team was extremely well coordinated and helpful.

Thank You Sujith and wish you all the best.

I would also like to specially thank the services of Mr. Sajad Lone ( Butler Service) who was extremely helpful and made all efforts to make our stay comfortable one. His service with a smile is still fresh in the mind. 

Thank You Sajad and wish you all the success.

reviews.author: Nazish A
reviews.title: Amazing !!
reviews.text:
Was travelling on a golf trip , we went for lunch at Khyber, it was simply awesome. Staff & Manager were too cordial. One person in particular was very polite & cordial, topping with most humble service was Mr. Sajjad. I had already read about his service on trip advisor and was surprised to see that he was our server. Great experience, ordered chinese food, was too good. 
Next time staying there for sure! Nazish &Amer

reviews.author: Pavane M
reviews.title: top of the line
reviews.text: The Khyber - it's a grand hotel which we arrived in after a wonderful trek. It was perfect for the rainy day outside - to sit in their lobby with the views and sip hot kahva. The rooms are luxuriously appointed and the bathrooms are every trekkers dream - rain showers in the mountains and a deep bath if you like - while you gaze out at the spectacular views. The beds are oh so important and these were like a warm hug!! It seemed to be a great family hotel, rooms for kids to find activities indoors for inclement weather et al. The pool and the spa crown the rest - warm water again with views!! And the spa adds to the luxury.

reviews.author: triphank
reviews.title: Best in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
I had a nice stay at the hotel this year in February. It is very close to Gondola and had a lot of ski shops nearby. 
The rooms have a nice mountain view and the Kashmiri food at the restaurant is awesome.

reviews.author: Sivakumar S
reviews.title: Our trip to Gulmarg.
reviews.text:
Friends this was our first time to Srinagar and its a 75 mins travel to Gulmarg there we received a very warm welcome from the team there.

We stayed in the presidential suite and we're ably assisted by Mr.Sajjad who was our Butler for the day.

We also enjoyed the offerings at the spa and found them to be well trained for the task.

In all it was a very memorable trip

reviews.author: pranav kapur
reviews.title: Pool with the view
reviews.text:
If you like the mountains you will love this Resort.
We booked the cheapest room so it did not have the best view but we hardly spent any time there.
Its a spa so they don't serve alcohol but I suggest you carry your best malt for that weather.
The indoor heated pool has got the best view so don't forget to take your trunks.

The only issue was the smell in the corridor which refused to go on both the days we were there for.

reviews.author: TrueIndian
reviews.title: Excellent Place to Unwind
reviews.text:
Situated on a hilltop in Gulmarg. Travelling time by car is approximately 1.5 hours from Srinagar airport.
Check In and Check Out is very swift.
On arrival one is greeted with "Kahwa" (Kashmiri Green Tea).Thereafter one is escorted to the room.
The rooms are very spacious with king beds with an attached balcony overlooking the meadows. 
The bathroom is also spacious with a bath tub also provided.
Although there is an air conditioner temperature control in the room but still the room becomes very hot at night and can lead to perspiration.
In room slippers and shoe shine are not available.
The resort has a gym, indoor swimming pool, and a spa.
There are multiple restaurants.
The menu includes dishes from all over the country but Kashmiri Wazwan is very delicious and worth trying once during your stay.
There is a convention hall also for meetings.
The resort is very close to Gulmarg Gandola entry.
The room tariff is very high but worth a visit.

reviews.author: sanjuverma
reviews.title: very good, calm and awesome hotel
reviews.text:
excellent hotel, all wood wood finish everywhere. I loved the place though expensive. we were greeted very warmly but at the entrance luggage was scanned and we were told to open bags, disappointing.
we paid Rs35800/- for two rooms for one night plus we paid Rs 5000/- extra for two kids. they gave us Gulmarg side view which was disappointed, we requested for mountain view rooms which was politely declined stating hotel is full. it was not true as one can see next morning, it was not even half occupied. staff is very polite and courteous but only in talking, not in making small favors for their guest. 

excellent indoor pool, Jacuzzi and sauna. enjoyed thoroughly. 
Wi-Fi is not free.

reviews.author: a2z_pune
reviews.title: Excellent location with beautiful decor!
reviews.text:
This a true 5 star hotel placed at excellent location.  The views it offers are absolutely breathtaking!  I went with my wife and kids and we truly enjoyed the stay. 

Pros: 
1.  Excellent property with great amenities.
2.  Courteous staffs
3.  Sumptuous breakfast

Cons:
1.  Expensive!
2.  Wifi per day costs INR 750/- per device which should have been complimentary.
3.  The local union at Gulmarg will make thing unpleasant.  You cannot park your own vehicle at the hotel or take it to the local market.  The hotel needs to put some check on them or at least allow complimentary drop or pick up from the local market.

At the moment Khyber is the only 5 star property in the region; and offers the experience you may want to have!

reviews.author: mahesh p
reviews.title: Decent stay at Gulmarg
reviews.text:
It was last week in September and season in kashmir was about to end.
We had a 2 day's decent stay here. Location of of the property is beautiful. Interior and decor was simple. It had all fine amenities but would not rate it as five star.
Entrance climb is so damn stiff that one can not think of walk down or up. Food was nice and had all kinds of cousine.

reviews.author: Shutterbugger
reviews.title: Great location, interiors & service. Bit pricey, but highly recommended
reviews.text:
We stayed there as a couple in Sep 2015. We found the tariff a bit steep but would be willing to repeat our stay in the winters there. Its a beautifully done up property with lovely landscaped lawns and pool/spa area. There are lots of steps inside and outside the resort - might be tough for the elderly or those with physical challenges.

We stayed in #4003 which was a non-balcony room. was spacious and comfortable. the higher priced balcony rooms with mountain view would be great if you're willing to pay up extra for the awesome view. balcony rooms with Gulmarg view don't have a special view - imo not worth the extra charges.

+ LOCATION-situated within 7-10 mins walking distance from the Gulmarg Gondola (cable car to Apharwat peak). helps steer clear of hiring ponies. on the flip side, the walk back from Gondola to the hotel is a bit steep and tiring for unfit people
+ INTERIORS-very well done up. comfortable and clean. modern, clean bathrooms. however, maintenance could be better in some areas (more below)
+ FOOD-found it to be decent. breakfast spread is very extensive (eggs, multiple south indian options, north indian, fruits, breads, juices etc). traditional kashmiri cuisine was really tasty
+ SERVICE-calls to the front desk and housekeeping were promptly answered and requests fulfilled quickly. wait staff at the restaurant was also good and very friendly.

- BATHROOM MAINTENANCE-one of the tiles in the bathroom was broken. shower area water was getting clogged due to drainage issues. found the bathtub a bit dirty and had to ask for it to be re-cleaned before using it. For the tariff they charge (comparable to 5*), these issues should not be there at all!
- CHARGEABLE WIFI-given its remote location and tariff being charged, it should have been wi-fi with limits on the # of devices allowed
- CENTRAL A/C- it gets uncomfortably hot during the day. perhaps it needs to recalibrate for summer months since temps definitely need to be a bit cooler than they are set in Aug/Sep. in-room controls don't work in modulating temperature

SPA-we used the spa for a neck,shoulder,head massage session. It wasn't bad but we've had better massages elsewhere. Didn't think there was anything distinctive here owing to the L'Occitane tag.

reviews.author: 198pradeep
reviews.title: Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa at Gulmarg, Kashmir, India- a heaven on earth
reviews.text:
Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa is situated in Himalayan town of Gulmarg, 56 kilometers from Srinagar, the capital city of state of Jammu and Kashmir in India.The resort is situated at altitude of almost 9000 feet in the picturesque valley in Himalayan Pir Panjal range.Khyber Resort is an ideal base to explore Kashmir valley and particularly to take a ride on world's highest sky lift, the Gulmarg Gondola, which connects Gulmarg to Kongduri mountain.

This 86 room resort provides enchanting and breathtaking view of meadows and forests of Kashmir valley and snow covered peaks of Himalayan mountain ranges. Each room in the resort provides this heavenly view, not only from the balcony but also from the washroom through full sized floor to ceiling windows. enjoying this heavenly view while taking tub bath is an unique  experience.
the rooms are well equipped and spacious and have a large balcony with comfortable relaxing chairs. The fittings and fixtures in rooms and washroom area are of high quality.
The resort has good spa, gym and heated swimming pool.
Khyber resort provides a great value for money.

reviews.author: Meha1234
reviews.title: very relaxing and beautiful
reviews.text:
We had heard a lot about the property and thus booked this as a treat to both me and my husband after our 10 day trip in leh. Though the hotel is pretty, few points they could improve on:
1. Due to less occupancy, the hotel did not look fully operational. Ex - no Buffet ( which was a disappointment for meat lovers) Also for veg, there were limited options apart from few mains in Indian dishes. 
2. Lights were dim throughout the hotel etc. 
3.The wifi was very slow
4.The hotel could add more activities and maintain the existing ones like snooker table a little better
5. The AC in the rooms don't work on individual need basis as the hotel is centrally managed. Hence in Aug, the room gets a bit too warm while sleeping.

The pluses:
1.The staff however, was very polite and courteous and ensured we have a lovely stay. The manager too went out of the way to get us an upgrade so we could enjoy the mountain view with a balcony. That made us feel really on top of the world literally and not made us feel the pinch in the wallet due to the high prices of the rooms even in off season. 
2. Quiet and relaxing
3. Rooms were very comfortable with excellent bathrooms. 
.
Overall, nice experience but would be better in season time when the hotel really looks beautiful with snow.

reviews.author: mansingala
reviews.title: Part of Heaven on earth
reviews.text: Have visited khyber twice..once in winter and recently in their summer days.. The experince ws awesome,i think specially the ambience, the view, the peace u get there is something u really dnt wanna miss it. Everything is nicely managed. Be it calabash, restaurants,spas...with helpful warm staff of fnb and manager mr. Aman makes sure tht his every guest leave with excel food and service memories.. Bcoz of these reasons we might feel to mesmorize our memories.. Few things in room service they need to work on but overall experience ws superb... Looking forward to visit soon..😊😊

reviews.author: AnnRa
reviews.title: Fantastic rooms!!!
reviews.text: The rooms are gorgeous and every detail is exquisite.. The lighting is beautiful and the scenery from the balcony is breathtaking... Though there are resorts with better view in gulmarg, the ambience of this place is to be experienced ..it is a stone 's throw from the gondola ticket window. However it would be good if the resort arranges drop /pickup from this point as it's a difficult steep climb esp with kids..the staff is polite but felt the service was mechanical and did not match the ambience of this place. No one approached us and asked if our stAy was good at any point in the 2 days v were there. The kids room called igloo should be housed in a glass like structure like the swimming pool.. Right now it is 2 floors down in a windowless room and seems out of place in this well designed resort. My husband visited the spa and gave a thumbs up for the experience, must do when at the hotel ..

reviews.author: noizemaker
reviews.title: 3х-дневная командировка в Кашмир
reviews.text:
Был в данном отеле в декабре, в течение трех дней. Командировка сложилась очень удачно, работы особо не было, поэтому была возможность оценить окружающий мир)
Отель находится в очень живописном месте, в Гималаях. Из окон открывается просто фантастический вид на заснеженные вершины. Природа и свежий горный воздух - это, наверное, основной плюс этого региона в целом. Но и минусов конечно не занимать. Начнем с того, что это Индия и даже "больше", что-то ближе к Пакистану и Афганистану. Это был уже мой второй визит в Индию, и я знал куда еду. Но вот мои товарищи по командировки были просто в ужасе от города Шринагар, где находится аэропорт, от нашей дороги в отели, дорожного движения, местных водителей, грязи, разрухи. Ну в общем, всего того, что делает Индию Индией))
Насколько я понимаю, люди едут в эти места в горнолыжных целях. Мы были немного с другой целью, но по канатной дороге все же поднялись. Ну так вот, ифраструктура этого горнолыжного "курорта" оставляет желать лучшего, точнее, наверное, оставляет желать хоть чего-то) Потому что там, собственно, ничего и нет. Может быть мы были не в сезон (снега еще было немного), либо были не совсем там. Думаю про регион - это все.
Теперь о самом отеле. Это пятерка. Достаточно уютная, красивая. Даже не по индийским меркам там очень комфортно. Хорошая инфраструктура: ресторан, тренажерный зал, бизнес-центр, своеобразная лаундж-зона с терассой и видом горы. Встретили нас очень душевно: напоили вкуснейшим кашмирским чаем. Не могу сказать, из чего конкретно он сделан, но он был настолько живительным и вкусным, что усталость с дороги как рукой сняло.
Номер был просторный и уютный, с балконом, вид на горы. Чистая ванная с большой душевой кабиной. 
Ресторан тоже отличный. У нас были включены завтраки - шведский стол. Там были и каши, и яичницы, всевозможная выпечка, мюсли, фрукты, орехи. В общем, очень разнообразно и по-европейски (поскольку от индийской кухни я не в восторге вообще). Так же мы в отеле и ужинали, за свой счет разумеется. Цены выше среднего, но не космические. Что самое интересное - очень вкусно. Я даже умудрился взять такое блюдо, в котором был выдержан некий баланс между местным колоритом и вкусом, близким европейскому языку)
Теперь о минусах:
1) Самый большой и главный - это платный интернет, тем более по диким тарифам. Может этому и есть какое-то объяснение, но платить в пятерке еще и за интернет - полнейший абсурд.
2) Тяжелое взаимопонимание с персоналом. Как я уже говорил, я был в Индии во второй раз, и прекрасно понимал, что русский человек с индусом общего языка не найдут (даже учитывая, что у меня лингвистическое образование и отличный английский), так тут еще и сказывалось, видимо, слабое знание персоналом английского. В общем, было тяжело. Особенно, когда мы пытались заказать стейк средней прожарки.
3) Лично для меня это минусом не было, поскольку я не пьющий вообще. Но для кого-то - да. Регион на 99% мусульманский, будьте готовы, что алкоголь не купить. Вообще. Нигде. Никак. В общем, берите с собой из дьюти фри)
4) Местный колорит и городок Гульмарг - это конечно совершенно другая Индия, не такая как на юге. Но и эта крайность немного пугает: местное население по большей части на вид самые настоящие талибы и моджахеды. Вообще, штат Кашмир - спорная территория, и там не очень спорно, периодически случаются терракты и т.д. В горах на дорогах стоят какие-то блокпосты и т.д. В общем, колоритненько))

reviews.author: sanjaysilli
reviews.title: Overall good experience
reviews.text:
I with my family stayed in this property in month of june '15. Ever smiling and helpful staff. The location and archtecture is spell binding.
The let down is the food and dinning area. The dinning hall is too small, cogested, crowded and choatic for otherwise such a fabulous property.
The food has limited range and average in quality.
The rest of the stay makes up for this short coming.

reviews.author: avinash678singh
reviews.title: Great place......
reviews.text:
Stayed at khyber in june....... The hotel is very well maintained and the service there was very nice and courteous.... We got rooms with nice views....
Loved the interiors at Khyber.....
Very luxurious and classy....

reviews.author: AkneogTikna
reviews.title: Can do better
reviews.text:
The title is a typical comment from my school days' report card.
- can do better
- still can do better
- good. but can do better with a little more effort
That's exactly how I felt. More involvement from the team & genuine warmth needed. I interacted with Jerin who showed me around the property quite a bit. Thanks for your personal attention.
Little more professional touch would do wonders.
Food menu also needs variety just like I mentioned for Pahalgam hotel & Vivanta Srinagar.
Views are great & luxuriously done all the way from reception to the bathroom to the amenities. ATTENTION MANAGEMENT - solve the seepage issues ASAP while your woodwork can be saved. Oh! and buck up with the check-out process!!!! None paying in the range of 20k per night finds it acceptable to wait anything in excess of 5-10 mins for baggage to be transferred from room to portico. We and other guests in our presence waited beyond half an hour!

reviews.author: neerajgoel
reviews.title: A perfect match with nature
reviews.text:
We stayed here in 2nd week of June 2015 a group of 20 people 5 families. The best stay one can imagine. Very nice property. Excellent location. Very nice rooms. The best food you can imagine of. Very good service. Excellent House keeping. Good Dinning. Very good Menu. Very nice spa. Heated pool is an added feature. Good security. Very nice view.

A few drawbacks : Charging 7 star property rates but no plants, no greenery inside hotel. A few plastic pots are placed but plants in bad position. Spread in 8 acres but no flowers. Parking system very bad. Our taxis were not allowed to stay in parking. So for 2 days we were without vehicle. The location of hotel is on a hill. So your climb from Market or Gandola ride to hotel is a night mare. No service of pick and drop from Hotel. Just the thought of climbing stops you to go outside. I strongly feel that hotel should provide these basic facilities. Other wise all ok.

reviews.author: Abhiroop
reviews.title: Awesome ecstatic place amidst the mountains but bad service
reviews.text: We were here for only 1 night since next day we had to leave for Srinagar. At first, when you enter you would feel the royalty that is presence in the decoration of the lobby and the surrounding areas. Exquisitely decorated interiors and wooden finishes all over the hotel is just amazing. Coming to the room, they upgraded me to the  mountains view room with a quite large balcony to sit and feel the calmness around. Everything is ok except for the service and no free Wifi to resident guests. Other hotels of lower category such as Vivanta by Taj  offer at least 24hrs of free usage but Khyber does not. Another point which disappoints you the most is the poor service when it comes to necessary in room services such as toiletries or such other things. Also they dont provide packages such as including one major meal or something of that sort which makes it a little tough on the pocket if you staying for 1 day. Apart from all of these, this is the best place to imbibe and feel the pure snowcapped mountains.

reviews.author: Siddhid
reviews.title: Heaven nestled in snow peaked mountains
reviews.text: Amazing royally done up property with excellent location in Gulmarg. Staff is nice and food is good too. Best to take the rooms with a private balcony overlooking the snow peaked mountain range. Thanks for the warm hospitality Kashmiri style!

reviews.author: Very L
reviews.title: Stunning hotel with soulless service
reviews.text:
The Khyber is a grand property worthy of the praises it has received, view were stunning, rooms were great and food served was excellent all at par with any 5-star international hotel. 

Physically it may live up to its reputation however the service was without soul especially front desk and mid level staff appeared not to be well trained and unmotivated.

And 5-star hotel charging for something as ubiquitous as wi-fi?

reviews.author: menonkk
reviews.title: Heavenly View
reviews.text: The entry to the hotel itself was awe inspiring.   The sight of the snow peaked mountains  from the hotel makes your jaw drop.  The lobby which is centrally heated makes a warm welcome from the chill outside.  The rooms are large  and spacious.  The washrooms  are elegant and neatly done. The  window  of the  bathroom offering view of nature is interesting and beautiful. The balcony opening to nature is nice place to relax and have a cuppa.  Good Health Club facilities. The view from  the Gymnasium and the heated swimming pool makes it very difficult to pull yourself out from these places. Can still improve on the food palate and food charges are exorbitant.  Staff are courteous and special thanks to Mr. Sajad who arranged to transport our misplaced camera  at the Hotel to Srinagar. The higher altitude makes breathing a bit difficult.

reviews.author: Gotta Travel
reviews.title: A destination in its own right
reviews.text:
There are those people who come to Gulmarg & then there are those who come to the Khyber. The Khyber has truly become a destination in its own right. Gulmarg was crying out for a property like this - top end rooms, very high end villas, good food & a great spa. 

The rooms are large, well appointed & comfortable. All the mod-cons are at your finger tips - temperature control, in room coffee/tea making making facilities, satellite TV, wifi (with slightly iffy speed & signal strength). The bathrooms are nice with a separate shower stall & a tub by the window. The tubs are perfect for a romantic soak as you watch the moon rise over the mountains. 

Room tip - ask for a room facing the spa because it's a better view though the rooms on the other side aren't shabby either. 

The hotel offers a multi cuisine restaurant, with both a buffet & a menu to choose from. The breakfast is a star meal with a live egg station and fabulous South Indian dosa-idli breakfasts. There is a tea lounge with a wide range of teas & coffees. If you are trying to kick the caffeine habit try the rose tea, it's amazing. 

A hookah or sheesha lounge is available tans is a nice place to spend the evening chatting & reliving the days experiences. 

Point to note - the hotel doesn't sell alcohol but will be happy to serve you your own if you bring it with you. 

The spa is a revelation with a lovely heated pool. Heaven is watching the snow come down as you lounge around in the pool. There is a gym with some basic free weights, a multi gym and some cardio equipment. I haven't tried the treatment rooms but it's a La Occitane spa so it must be great. 

So whether it's a honeymoon, a family holiday or a skiing trip this is a great place to stay.

reviews.author: Shaan S
reviews.title: Worth it.
reviews.text:
This hotel was simply amazing, the mountain view rooms are spectaculars and the location of the hotel was next to the action but super quite since it was slightly up a hill. The service was fantastic, although some management issues prevailed as only one restaurant was functional and too many visitors in the hotel, they had a cafe with seating but refused to open it for any meals this meant waiting 10 mins to be seated. I really loved this hotel and I'd suggest it to anyone that can afford it! One thing that brought me down majorly was the crowd, super noisy in outdoor spaces and not very pleasing to to be around, one couple was swimming fully clothed in the pool which really put me off from swimming there, even though the pool was heavenly with a spectacular view! 

I would highly recommend this hotel!

reviews.author: VanessaMunYee
reviews.title: fantastic view
reviews.text:
This luxury resort located right at the hilltop from the Cable car station and we could just hike from the resort to some really nice alley

The lobby is huge however the staff took so long to check us in. We had to go for lunch first while waiting for the check in. 

Our room was huge and clean with a couch and a balcony with fantastic view. We had a comfortable bed. Bathroom was clean and big with enough amenities.

They have a restaurant with excellent mountain view.

Wifi is not free.

reviews.author: NaseemVora
reviews.title: Nestling in the woods of Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Our first impression was very favourable, as it is crafted with great love. the wooden exteriors and the interiors are gorgeous! We were escorted to a lobby and served warm Kehwa while all the formalities were taken care of. The food was very good, though standard. The breakfast buffet was extensive and the service very prompt.
The road upto the hotel is pretty steep, so walking up and down was a little tiring.
It is located right next to the Gondola, so that is convenient. The entire staff was very warm and welcoming. 
However the rooms we had were on the lower floors and my childrens room actually looked out onto the car park. so that even the drivers etc could look in and there was no privacy at all. 
Another strange thing was that the rooms had only heating facilities, not air conditioning. so no fresh air was coming in at night, and it would get pretty stuffy. The alternative was opening the windows. But that was a security issue on the lower floors. 
Also a library would be very welcome. Also, free wifi would be very welcome. The paid wifi was pretty steep

reviews.author: Buthello
reviews.title: Team Offsite
reviews.text:
We couldn't have chosen a better hotel than Khyber.
The view from the resort is breathtaking. The rooms are amazing... Every room has a view. 

The heated pool is a delight.
The spa operated by lo'ctaine is clean and very nice.

The staff is warm.

reviews.author: Jeswanthr
reviews.title: Nice hotel, but service can improve
reviews.text:
It is a great property and I guess the best to stay in Gulmarg. The location is also very good very close to cable ride station. The hotel room is very well kept as well and the views are also good. The food is also nice. 

On the minus side the service was just ok, it seemed to me that the staff was not trained enough.

reviews.author: rupal k
reviews.title: Fantastic property but just not warm enough!
reviews.text:
Positives:
Great view
Beautiful rooms 
Fantastic food
Very peaceful 

Def the best Gulmarg's got

Negatives:
Arrogant senior staff
Need reminding twice atleast for anything the guests may need
No extra efforts taken to make sure the guests are comfortable
Everyone here has duties which they carry on fantastically without even glancing at their guests to greet them 
Having stayed at some great properties one gets spoilt for the service, the warmth was definitely missing.

Would still recommend it simply for the location and the view!

reviews.author: Jasmin1963
reviews.title: paradise on earth
reviews.text: Khyber is the best resort to spend quality time with family,it amazingly beautiful with majestic Himalayan view.Restuarants & Spa provided good experience with wide range of relaxing & rejuvinating treatments.

reviews.author: Saurabh Agarwal
reviews.title: Great Experereince at Gulmarg
reviews.text:
This is great property at Gulmarg. As Gulmarg is very small town there are very few options. First let me inform about Gulmarg City as there is no local civilization due to government has declared as "No Civilization Zone" due to weather conditions and due to the heritage value the town has. This is the reasons there are no new development  in this town. Hence there are very few hotel available. 

We stayed here though the hotel is 5 star deluxe but due to it's monopoly there is absence of customer delight services. The location of  hotel is beautiful and services provided by the hotel is as per the standard no extra customer delight like in The Lalit Grand Palace, Srinagar. Both the property can not comparable in term of service or it's ascetic value. The Gondola ride is just stone throw away from the hotel. The hotel has internal temperature controlled leisure pool which is lovely. The fragrance of aroma  would definitely refresh you. The food is good though the variety for vegetarian is less due to reason explained above in my review.

reviews.author: ssamra
reviews.title: Something is missing
reviews.text: Khyber is the best option in beautiful Gulmarg. Even towards end of April Gulmarg was all covered in snow. Hotel location is excellent and very near to Gondola boarding point. Staff is very good and so is food, spa and all other hotel facilities. But something seems to be missing to rate this property excellent. When I compare  it with Oberoi's hospitality at Wildflower Hall or Cecil Shimla or with the newly opened JW Marriott at Mussoorie, I definitely feel something is missing for the price I paid. But I am well compensated with the beauty of Gulmarg. Gondola ride to  Apharwat  is not to be missed. If you afford Khyber is the only choice to stay at Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Yashwant Jhabakh
reviews.title: Holiday with some friends
reviews.text: What a super place ...... Heaven on earth... loved every part of the hotel .   The indoor swimming pool is just super ... lovely Cieling height and large glass windows .... simply divine.... would love to come to this place again and spend a week skying.

reviews.author: YusuF P
reviews.title: Best of everything
reviews.text:
The hotel service and rooms are both excellent. the best part about it is that it is situated closely to the Gondola ride, which is a walking distance from the property.

amazing amenities, excellent rooms and all with such fantastic view. we were lucky to have snow at the time of our stay, which just romanticized the entire holiday. 

Lovely food and excellent service with a special care towards children.

reviews.author: Bhingri
reviews.title: Exotic!
reviews.text:
Gulmarg is arguably the most beautiful place on earth and Khyber adds luxury to it. The location is good- quite close to the Gondola. The decor is tasteful. Rooms are spacious and clean. (Loved their bedcovers with exquisite kashmiri work on it). Views are breathtaking. The swimming pool, jacuzzi and sauna are fun. Taking a dip in heated swimming pool looking at the snow all around is an experience. The restaurant serves decent food. It is commendable how they run the hotel at such a height. 
However, their service is a mixed package. The reception staff and restaurant staff were helpful and courteous, while some others were very cold and unwelcoming. For some unknown reason, there was no minibar in the room. The bathtub was clean but in a bit rundown condition. The water in the shower was spilling outside even with closed door. Bathroom slippers were missing. 
One big issue is that they do not have any arrangement for the drivers. Most of the people who come here use taxis, hence the concern for driver is very relevant. The outside temperature is pretty low for the driver to spend the night in the vehicle. They have to rush down to Tungmarg - 10-12 km down the hill and come up every time we need their service. They do not want to wait at the hotel because if there is heavy snowfall or any such problem, if the car refuses to start due to cold, they claim that the hotel is very unhelpful and the they get into a fix.
 
So, all in all, its a mix package of goodies with the hotel, but Gulmarg with all its uniqueness and charm makes your trip memorable for sure :)

reviews.author: Mohashak
reviews.title: A  beautiful property with amazing views
reviews.text:
We have been travelling all over the world and have stayed in some very good hotel, but this hotel is truly special, the view from our room was amazing with the added bonanza of snowfall during our trip which our kids loved, very courteous and helpful staff, although the check in is a bit complicated. Even though the front office staff try to minimize the hassle. The hotel should keep some OTC medecines as we wanted panadol for my son which was not available , and there was no option as shops close early. But to sum up a great place visit and stay.
Mohammed
Kuwait

reviews.author: BHMDUDE
reviews.title: Khyber#Snow#Location#View
reviews.text: What a location . A luxury resort in the lap of nature. Snow everywhere. Service is good. Only downside is food. Food prices are too high. INR 150 for one roti. Apart from food everything else was great. A must stay in gulmarg. Gondola is very close to the resort. Resort was fully covered in snow when we visited i.e. 22/03/2015. Enjoy the snow within the hotel premises. Great spa and swimming pool. Truly a five star resort. I am giving 4 stars not 5 stars because of food . Food were priced liked anything and taste doesn't matches the prices. Otherwise a great stay.

reviews.author: ArianPranav
reviews.title: Heaven in snow, but bit costly...
reviews.text: We went there with a group of 3 families during January and stayed for three days. Though the resort is on costly side but at such a high altitude its tuff to offer such 5 star stuff. There is indoor pool of warm water and there are ample games for kids including two X-box. They have dedicated 1-2 SUV which can take you to Gondola (rope-way) ride. They provide rubber boots for guests including kids while they want to enjoy playing in snow. Food was having lot of variety and offerings were nice. Buffet is served for breakfast, lunch and dinner which have ample options. Since it was snowing outside so remained indoor most of the time. Overall the resort is centrally heated which makes it convenient for elders and kids for most of the time while outside the temperatures are in minus. They offer kahwa as welcome drink which make you indulge in Kashmiri spirits….

reviews.author: Nils Ola B
reviews.title: Great hotel with fantastic service
reviews.text:
Great hotel with fantastic service and nice spa. Close to ski lifts and Monkey Hill for those randonee trips on a bad weather day. Although, most visitors are less interested in ski (I honestly do not get why they are visiting Gulmarg in winter time other than staying at a good hotel). Food is good as well, although you get kind of tired of the buffet on the fourth day... 
I miss a small bar where those after ski beers can be bought. And naturally, a glass of read wine with my curry would also be nice:)

reviews.author: suja1322
reviews.title: Snow oasis
reviews.text: I went in early March with group of friends and we were totally mesmerised with the location and kashmiri interior. The swimming pool and spa were amazing. However the food in restaurant was below the expectation and we could find much better food at other hotels in Gulmarg!

reviews.author: Sandeep_Raturi
reviews.title: Loved my stay here  !
reviews.text:
Loved my stay at the hotel. 

You can't beat the location. Simply one of the best Hill Resorts in India. New hotel but built in a style that gives its Lobby a Heritage and classy look. A lot of wood work in the hotel. Framed photographs (depicting Kashmiri culture) are used as artwork instead of paintings. Rooms are carpeted, fairly spacious (350 sq ft) and offers stunning views of the pine trees and slopes. I visited during the heaviest snowfall and the views were surreal. The pool area is very good and looks amazing with wild pine trees just behind the glass wall. Play area to keep the kids busy. Wifi is chargeable and so is the mini Theatre. 

The staff at the hotel is predominantly Kashmiris and this I personally think is highly commendable  as employment to locals is the necessary component of Eco Tourism. 
The check-in at the hotel was smooth and quick. We were given a hot cup of 'Kahwa' in the coffee lounge and by the time we finished our drink, the keys were ready and we were escorted to the room not by a porter but by a smart front office executive himself. Room service is prompt and orders were ready in no time. I waited for only 15 minutes for the Dinner to be served in the room. However the quality of service is not uniform as one would expect from a luxury hotel. The dinner plates were not cleared till my check-out next morning. This is unimaginable for a luxury resort.  More training is required for the staff especially at the restaurant. During breakfast, I had to ask for water and tea/coffee. In a Luxury resort and for that matter in any good hotel/resort, it is expected from the waiters to keep a tab on the tables and fill/refill glass of water even before the guests ask for it. I asked for a glass of water and I was given one and still the water was not served to my family which is nothing but a  lackadaisical attitude of the service staff.  But these are minor glitches and I am sure it will improve with times. 
Bathrooms are spacious with bathtub, shower cubicle and a transparent window that separates it from the bedroom. If the blinders are up, you can enjoy the view of the pine trees from the bathtub itself. Wooden blinders looks good but messy to operate. If I start nitpicking, I would be tempted to say that the WC shower appears tacky and very low quality.
The food is said to be highlight of the hotel. I am a vegetarian and not a foodie so can't comment much on it but have heard very good things about the food at this hotel. One should know that there is NO BAR at the hotel so one must come prepared with his stuff packed. There is a nice Cigar lounge for the smokers. 

I work for a travel company and overall I find it a very nice resort which I can easily recommend to my clients. I loved my stay in the hotel.

reviews.author: Prateek_Rungta
reviews.title: A must stay when in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Stayed for 2 nights at Khyber in the month of February 2015. Excellent location, great property. Very close to the gandola and other ski places. The lobby and restaurants have a great ambiance. Rooms are well done but slightly small. The balconies & common areas have decent views - we had 2 feet of snow inside the balcony and a blanket of white all around.
The staff is very helpful - bell boys, front desk, security and housekeeping.
However, at approx INR 21000 per night may not be quite value for money.
Overall, great experience and would highly recommend it to first time visitors to Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Petlifying
reviews.title: Experience Khyber in the winters at least once in a lifetime
reviews.text:
enjoyed the stay tremendously.... The cold outside and the lovely temperatures within. The big glass facades that give excellent views . Unforgettable experience. The warmth of the pool the bubbling jacuzzi, The spa experience (La Occitane) was just too great to explain 
Will definitely be here in the summers too .

reviews.author: bestfood029
reviews.title: Heavenly Luxury.
reviews.text:
Better late than never writing a review :) So yes, you guessed it right , the completely justify the money that they charge from you and they are completely worth that bomb that you paid :). our one night stay at gulmarg was really beautiful cos the place is stunningly beautiful and maintained exceptionally well , the lobby is grand and the interiors are royal. the service is almost impeccable except the food wasnt as great as I expected. 
The rooms are large and so are washrooms , and the view from the balcony will make you feel like never to go back . the place is just a walk away from gondola and we drove for yummy north indian eat out for dinner which was also awesome ! Given a chance , I would certainly want to go back to be there and witness the white beauty again!

reviews.author: AvyaP
reviews.title: Beautiful is the word
reviews.text: beautiful property with great indoor facility plus extremely mesmerizing surrounding. would recommend more for people either on honeymoon/ big group as there are lot of activities to do be done both indoor as well as outdoor

reviews.author: JoshSZ
reviews.title: Great Place to Stay
reviews.text: Didn't know what to expect coming to Gulmarg.  Our Heli-Skiing operation gave us the option to stay at a few different places around Gulmarg and we chose Khyber because one of our group wasnt snowboarding... very happy that we made that choice.  Hotel staff is very friendly and willing to help but sometimes it was difficult to understand what they were saying (nit-picking but thats why 4 stars, not 5).  However, they were always eager to help.  The facility is very nice and comfortable... rooms, restaurant (food pretty good and lots of options) spa.  Would definitely come back to stay at The Khyber if/when I come back to Gulmarg.  Also, its just next to the gondola so getting up and down from the mountain so if youre planning to ski/snowboard, its a great location

reviews.author: Lee Alexander R
reviews.title: The best hotel in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
The Khyber is a good hotel and certainly offers better accommodation and facilities than any other hotel in the village. It is conveniently located close the gondola - short walk down the hill in ski boots and then straight up the mountain for powder skiing challenges! The staff are friendly, the rooms are spacious, beds are comfortable and the food is adequate Indian cuisine - not the best but sufficient to satisfy a calorie recharge after a days hard skiing. Could the hotel be better? Certainly, some more attention to fixing problems would not go amiss - the shower in my room was partially broken; the furniture was scratched and looked a bit tired; and the bathroom shower gels and shampoo were never replaced and were running low by the time I left. Moreover, the sound-proofing between rooms leaves little to ones imagination. 

The warm swimming pool and spa facilities were good and looked out on the spectacular mountain scenery. The airport transfers were great and on time. On balance it is a hotel I would stay at again when skiing in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: SamayGambhir
reviews.title: Amazing holiday
reviews.text: I feel that it was the best hotel in the area. The staff are extremely polite, helpful and efficient. the views of the balcony and nouf are amazing. The rooms at the hotel were amazing. There were good bathrooms in the room. Every room had a heating system.   The location is amazing for a person visiting for an outdoor activity. It is a minute away from the gondola cable car service and 5 minutes away from the golf course/ beginner slopes in ski season. The design of the room was very thoughtful. The highlight of the hotel was the pool and spa complex. They have a heated pool and separate jacuzzis, saunas and steam baths for men and women. Just sitting in the jacuzzi after 5 hours of skiing was very relaxing. The view from the swimming pool is amazing. you feel the warmth of the pool while looking at the snow capped himalayas. I however did not use the spa. The hospitality provided by the hotel was great. The only downside was that the facilities at the igloo (gaming area) were not so good. They had only two games for the xbox and used all sorts of equipment for different games. They have a really good restaurant. the kashmiri kahwa is a must try. special meantion to the staff Ishfaq(restaurant), Sajad Ahmed Lone(restaurant and Gulzar(housekeeping). Overall it was an amazing holiday.

reviews.author: MFNAZ
reviews.title: Best resort
reviews.text: We stayed here in the month of July,it was the best experience  we had.staff of the hotel is well trained.Hotel is newly built n will take time to get better in all aspects.We enjoyed our stay.Would love to visit again.

reviews.author: Avijit D
reviews.title: Has the potential to mature into its distinctive uniqueness....
reviews.text:
It's important to state, at the onset that khyber, is just a couple of years old. So its distinctiveness & certain elements of its character is yet to evolve. But certainly got the start going for it, which has put Gulmarg glamourously on the map of snow destinations.

The Architecture and the picturesque setting, modern bathrooms, heated indoor pool, the spa and being a short trot away from the Gondola are definitely spectacular starts. It's probably the most comfortable and luxurious that you can get as a winter destination. Is an Must do experience.

The human interactions, the distinctive food as well as integration with the local culture & environment is what creates lasting impressions. Food for thought, as Khyber i am sure, will go about creating its distinctive uniqueness in years to come.

Allow me to elaborate.....

Will always remember Gul Chacha, our guide and the chacha for the whole Gulmarg. Will remembers the conversations with locals @ Bakshi dhaba down at the village. Unfortunately, don't remember any such human interactions @ Khyber which have made an impact. Pakizah at the front desk was sweet & did stretch herself to attend to our needs. Should be mentioned. An unfortunate start to our stay at Khyber was that while checking in, the front desk announced that the transfer that we had made prior to arrival was short by 11k INR, so if we could settle that first before settling into our rooms. After showing email interactions with Imran Khan @ reservations, the front desk apologized that they had made an error and everything was paid. Maybe systems issue, but was not a very great start to human interactions within 15 mins of arriving @ Khyber.
