Surprisingly Kashmiri dishes were not part of the room service menu. The buffet dinner was standard stuff without any emphasis on local culture & cuisine. The Tabak Maas and the roganjosh that we ordered Ala-carte, was similar or worse than what we have had at any restaurant at Delhi or Mumbai or other metros.

Little details could have made the difference. Gondola tickets made available right at the hotel for example, anti-skid mats in the showers (and please do away with the decorative carpet in the bathroom. Slipped and almost fell twice), personalised butlers, more seating capacity for breakfast across the property, are some of the suggestions, which could be positive steps in the right direction.

Will probably return to experience Khyber 2.0

reviews.author: Amios7368
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text:
The Gm, the finest smiling man greeting 24/7,the food great the staff receptive 
A must visit to the travellers who like cold weather conditions, 
Only drawback no bar, I trapped in the hotel nothing to do, if travelling alone
Swimming pool fabulously heated 
Kahva should be served at tea time with snacks complimentary, 
The  restaurant staff super good.... 
 Concierge and travel desk absent though all staff helpful but would prefer a full time desk. 
Also a suggestion for a kashmir goods shop very much required. 
Overall herbert and his team delighted, even the financial officer was seen over seeing things, good sign............... 
Well done guys

reviews.author: GurgaonShaishav
reviews.title: The best resort in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Stayed at Khyber, in the first week of January 2015. The big attraction of Gulmarg - the Gandola, is very close to the resort.

Experience - very good, to start with. They welcome you with a hot Kahwa - which was very good. Checked in well, The pickup at the Srinagar hotel was also well organised (costs additional). Staff is well trained, ready to help you in which ever way they can. From giving advice, to giving contact numbers for shopping etc, they will also help you in every possible side. Room service was prompt, always delivered the tea / snacks in time. Spa - is a luxury. Steam room / Sauna / Jacoozi / Gym are well maintained. The restaurant (only one operational) had good cooked food. And the B/fast spread was also nice.
Some let downs though : The Bathrooms - will not give a five star resort look. Tiles (at least in our room - 2003) were not well set. Could see the strains, easily. The Shower point would leak, makign the external wooden area wet. To operate the shower, one had to go in and get some cold water, before you get the hot water experience. Somethign wrong with the shower.
There was no choice of the restaurants (although, as I said, the one restaurant did serve good food),
Some names, worth mentioning. Sujith H, GM, was very courteous to give us cash and add the same to our final bill. ATMs somehow are very difficult to find in Gulmarg. Atir in the F&B was always there to greet us in the restaurant and help us get everything fresh. Muzaffar in the hookah bar - his service / approach - should be appreciated.

reviews.author: ramaaIndia
reviews.title: Beauty , with some beast issues .
reviews.text:
We stayed in Khyber  during the last week of December  2014 . The hotel is built very close to the gondola and is a visual treat . There was some snow , and we  were awed with the entire experience of driving in into the  hotel..The lobby  was mind blowingly awesome and the kahwa delicious . Our check in  was very smooth , in fact the service was excellent throughout our stay .Every staff member was very courteous and eager to please . The restaurant staff especially were extremely  courteous and  prompt in their service . Food was exorbitantly expensive , but then in Gulmarg ,  choices are few . Sheer pampering during the spa sessions , very professional . 
Letdown - quality of sleep , we were in the  premier rooms  and there was an issue with the heating   in the room , the room felt stuffy at night  and though the problem was instantly attended to , it just spoilt that night for us . We again faced the same issue on our second night stay there , but we slept through as we were tired , having gone to apharwat that day 
This was not expected , for a five star luxury resort and it was a definite letdown after having stayed in the Hyatt group of hotels in the same trip.
This apart , Khyber is a very beautiful  place to stay in and enjoy for sure ! would maybe stay there again .

reviews.author: ZMR
reviews.title: GREAT STAY
reviews.text: What a wonderful location...... A great place to base yourself to visit the stunning Gulmarg . Really enjoyed our stay at the exceptional rooms , overlooking the snow covered mountain side. As for the staff, from the GM to all his support team, a very big thumbs up. Exceptional level of hospitality and care. The rooms with balconies ( upgraded rooms from what I was told) have a fantastic layout and facilities. Some pointers though: ..in winter, oil heaters maybe more useful as the room gets very dry with the air-conditioning heaters. It will be good to have some heathers in the bathrooms. The buffet at the restaurant was average.  Overall, a memorable experience and well worth recommending to others

reviews.author: Rohitas
reviews.title: The only worthwhile place to stay in gulmarg
reviews.text: Everything is good about Khyber. The booking department is the only weak link in the whole experience. The Staff members are courteous. They have a sense of ownership. In short, it's really worth gking at least once

reviews.author: Harsh J
reviews.title: great view and good amenities
reviews.text: This is one of the hotels which i have liked and stayed there for a day though, but there were some nik naks which were to be addressed to like the in room facilities to be looked into. etc but was a great experience there. heard that sometimes there are a few lions that come but as the property is guarded it is ok.

reviews.author: Praveen Rao
reviews.title: Great Location, Good Staff, Expensive Food!
reviews.text:
Khyber is indeed #1 place to be in when you are in Gulmarg. The location is superb, the rooms are luxurious and neat, views are fantastic. The staff is friendly and helpful. The hotel has good amenities for kids (Igloo with Xbox deployed, staff to engage kids, etc.)
The food is highly overpriced and the hotel is at such an elevation where you have to think twice before stepping out to dine out. Hence, it is highly recommended to go for a package, which bundles airport pickup and drop, two meals.

reviews.author: alientravelbug
reviews.title: Location is whoa....!! Total experience is good !!
reviews.text:
Stayed at the hotel for an annual business meet for the company i work with. Hotel location... exceptional... Hotel design .. Superb !! Room design .. Great, but ventilation seems to be an issue.. Breakfast... Grand and definitely not to be missed. Housekeeping can be expedited ... a little slow most of the times !

But definitely will recommend a stay with family and friends whenever you get a chance.

reviews.author: Suman G
reviews.title: Hyped
reviews.text: wonderful sprawling property. rooms were a little smelly. Food wasn't all that good. Spa was good. swimming pool wasn't functional. Room Service is extremely slow. Staff is courteous and warm. But by far the best property in Gulmarg so far

reviews.author: khush79
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL PROPERTY
reviews.text:
We stayed at this property about 10 days ago and thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

Large spacious room, with a sit out and spacious bathroom.

At the beginning service in the restaurant was dismal.Chipped glasses on the table, non attentive waiters, and clearance of plates not done in time during buffet lunch services. In the coffee lounge, the ginger tea served , had no taste of ginger at all and our change was not returned till we asked for it after a good 25 minutes of waiting. When we asked to speak to the FNB MGR or GM , we were told , both were away.

We spoke about our  unhappiness to  Mr Zaffar at the Front Office and then to the REST MGR, and after that service ,during dinner and b/fast was impeccable.

Beautiful lawns, great scenery, a must stay at this property.

reviews.author: Manan M
reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.text: One of the finest hotels I have been through..amazing location.. Eye soothing ambience.. Well equipped gym .. Food was nice too... Anyone visiting Gulmarg, must book a stay at Khyber if looking forward to luxury..! Cooperative staff, especially Mr.Kamal Singh rawat. Thank you for all the support.

reviews.author: Manish S
reviews.title: Very Good Hotel,and very bad staff !!!
reviews.text:
i have been visiting Kashmir since 2008 , almost every year . i always stay at the Lalit in Srinagar ,and used to make a day drip to gulmarg since there wasn't any luxurious Hotel in Gulmarg . The hotel rooms are beautifully furnished especially the luxury balcony rooms (where i stayed).the bathroom is one of the finest i have ever experienced in any hotel in India. It is indeed a luxury to avail of such wonderful amenities in the heart of Gulmarg.
Special thanks to Mashood Ahmad at Reservations for allocating rooms nears the lobby , as i had requested prior to my visit for my parents comfort  . (advisable for elderly people to stay near the lobby , else the further the better ).
the Negative are some staff , who are ill trained and absolutely ill mannered  .
 The WORST front desk staff i have ever come across in any hotel is SHAKEEL . I doubt , whether he is fit for any industry, let alone hospitality ! He does not know how to greet the guests , nor does he know how to use simple words like THANK YOU or SORRY . 
My F&B bill was Rs 9720 , He did not even bother to say thank you , Nor did he return the change of Rs80 , (i had TIPPED almost rs 5000 in KHYBER itself ) As nothing works without tipping in Kashmir.
i would have let go of this petty amount , BUT i was waiting there to see  , whether this Ill mannered disgusting , insult to the human race person  SHAKEEL , ignored me , while i was waiting for my change , for which he kept me waiting for like 10 minutes . Ultimately i had to ask him for it and yes , he did give the change back , making a pathetic face !!!
SHAKEEL , one advise to you , you can earn more money by begging in Mumbai , than fleecing the customers on vacation .                                                               Guests , please DO NOT expect anything special from the staff EXCEPT some restaurant staff especially mr khan , who was brilliant . AVOID  the front desk staff at any cost .

reviews.author: RitasishB
reviews.title: Good stay, fantastic view of Gulmarg landscape from rooms
reviews.text:
Stayed there for 2 days in August with family. This hotel is located in a spectacular strategic location and undoubtedly has one of the best view of Gulmarg landscape from the room and the terrace. The staffs were nice and courteous. The rooms are very good with a combination of modern and traditional Kashmiri interior decor, spacious washrooms. Food was quite good and the breakfast buffet had good options to choose from. It has a temp controlled swimming pool (with Jacuzzi), recreational room for kids and adults. The Gondola station is very near to the hotel and max 5 mins walk (you can avoid the unnecessary bargaining with the ponnywallahs). 
Now coming to the let-downs..The check in process was not smooth at all. A non-smiling person was sitting in a small check-in counter and instead of greeting people was busy with his computer and doing all other things than giving me the room key. While checking out also, I was lucky enough to do it fast whereas I was witnessing people waiting for 30 mins as their luggage still didn't arrive. The surely need more people and expertise in that area. The person in the main coffee shop was rude and like me many guests were disappointed by his rude behavior. Another suggestion is the hotel should arrange for a complementary drive to the gondola station (which can be 2 mins max). I could see people was being fooled by the private car rentals and ponnywallahs just outside the hotel gate, who were charging 300-500 rupees for a one way ride.

reviews.author: Manshu
reviews.title: Just visited restaurant for snacks
reviews.text:
Fantastic property what great views - wish we had decided to stay here, the food was good, the service also great. 
Will recommend that even if not staying in Gulmarg - go there for a meal or a beverage and enjoy the view from outside the coffee shop

reviews.author: SCenturion
reviews.title: Almost Excellent
reviews.text:
This property has aged within a year to look and feel rather old and worn out.  I spoke to management and they advised they have been sold out since opening, and were unable to perform some maintenance rituals.  The will have to figure it out because the setting and the property are spectacular indeed.  

The staff is fantastic and the Kashmiri hospitality is genuine and unparalleled.  The high altitude made my parents a little sick, but the staff doctor arrived immediately and was very helpful.  He was kind enough to return the next day to check upon them, without us calling him.

There was chaos at check-in, they could use more staff there.  The main coffee shop could also use better management.

The L'occitane spa is excellent and I enjoyed a relaxing treatment here.  But why won't the hotel use L'occitane or other aromatherapy remedies for the entrance is beyond my comprehension.  The entrance to the hotel was constantly smelling of pest control and insecticides.  Please figure out a less toxic option for your hotel and for the guests.

reviews.author: Bindun
reviews.title: A place to explore beauty
reviews.text:
Best hotel in whole gulmarg, with temperature controlled room, ice outside your rooms was amazing experience in my life. It has very cooperative staff. bath area is very spacious.
In my room temp control was not  working they tried in all ways to make my stay comfort with providing extra heaters.

reviews.author: parag s
reviews.title: Good, luxurious stay!
reviews.text:
Stayed at the Khyber on 14th August with my wife. 

Beautifully done up hotel. It is just 2 years old but has already gathered enough kudos for itself including empanelment with the Small Luxury Hotels (slh.com).

On arrival, we were given a complementary kashmiri kehwa which was the best kehwa we had during the trip. 

The rooms were very well done up in standard 5-star way with a great view of the mountain peaks. The hotel has quite a few facilities for families - a heated swimming pool, a gymnasium and a kids play area called the igloo. No wonder that most of the other occupants of the hotel were families with kids. 

The hotel is very close (5 mins walking distance although it is a steep slope) to the gulmarg gondola starting point which is the chief tourist attraction in gulmarg. 

We felt that the food was extremely expensive. They have a buffet dinner priced at INR 1600 which we thought was a lot. 

Nonetheless, its a great property and ideal if one was looking to simply relax for a couple of days.

reviews.author: anishkila
reviews.title: The Crown of Gulmarg!
reviews.text:
If you've been to Gulmarg, you'd know there isnt much to do other than the Gondola ride, which I would suggest continue to Level 2, else dont do it. Also level 2 isnt what they advertise it to be, there is a patch of snow for your cool 'FB' pics, and a rocky trek of 20 min to satisfy that pseudo adventure holidaying spirit in you.

Coming back to the point, Khyber then to me is the next best thing, not just because no other property comes close to the grandeur but because it is such a vast upgrade over the rest that when you see the difference in the rack rates, you also know the reason why!

Beautifully built over the hill top, its got one hell of a steep entrance, so walking it is quite a pain, the ongoing dispute between the donkey guys and taxi guys means, you need to fork out a fat bunch everytime you wish not to slug it on your feet.

We personally didnt have the best of rooms and it took a while for them to figure out which ones were undergoing maintenance and which werent, but then there is no looking back ( other than the fact the neighbouring maintenance went on till 11 and was a little disturbing nonetheless).

I would always choose the valley view over the mountain view, cuz i dont care much for the barbed fences on the mountain side, the view however is still really beautiful on both sides.

For food, there are limited options, but quite good. The spa had tied up with L'occitane, so company loyalists would happily fork out the money.

The biggest blemish! they dont have a liquor license, so no drinks. Also few of the added features like quad-bikes, guided treks, private cinema etc are all unreasonably expensive.

Wouldnt dream of staying elsewhere if ever in Gulmarg again, although not much to revisit.

reviews.author: Neeraj Raheja
reviews.title: Excellent location and great service
reviews.text:
We were a large group of 12 adults and 7 kids and didn't want to compromise on our last destination in Kashmir and wanted it to be truly luxurious and I must say that The Khyber stood true to its reputation. The check-in was through a warm welcome by Mr.Zafar and complimentary Kawa for all of us which we all enjoyed. Can't complain that the check-in took a little while as we were a large group and a lot of us got busy checking out the beautiful hotel.

The rooms allotted to us we're all good and on the same floor. Must say that rooms with view opening to the swimming pool and the garden have better views than the rooms on the other side. Having said that the size of the rooms and the luxurious bathrooms and the balcony offer you just the relaxation that you are looking for.

The quality of food was excellent. Though a little on the expensive side we thoroughly enjoyed the buffet breakfast, ala-carte and buffet dinner. Yes it is true that the restaurant gets a little crowded during peak times but doesn't take like hours for one to find a seat.

Another point worth noting was that the hotel had an in house doctor to cater to any health needs of children with medicines being available in the hotel itself. It also has a large play area for kids called the Igloo which had a lot of games for the kids like air hockey, x-box, board games, blocks, etc

Overall a very enjoyable and memorable experience. Would love to go back in the future.

reviews.author: sunilkatariya
reviews.title: Khyber
reviews.text: The property was good and the service was ok. Given the price, they charge, I would rate them who just meets the expectations. However quality and variety in breakfast was not so great and also found the buffet dinner priced on the higher side.

reviews.author: Goabizzle
reviews.title: Nice 5 star property
reviews.text: We visited in July 2014 with 2 rooms for the family.  We were greeted by a very friendly lady staff at the reception.  We really liked the rooms, it was clean and had a perfect view of the place.  I would definitely recommend this property.  The buffet however is catered mainly to vegetarians and with only 1 chicken and 1 fish dish for the non vegetarians so please check this before you book.

reviews.author: Samyak M
reviews.title: Excellent Location
reviews.text:
This is probably one of the finest places one can stay in gulmarg. The property is simply beautiful with a breathtaking view of the himalayas from the rooms.
The staff is extremely friendly (though the accent might make you feel that they aren't warm), and the rooms are very well appointed. Though the walls are very thin and you can practically hear almost everything from the next room.

The hotel is very close to the Gandola Ride - which is supposed to be the main attraction in Gulmarg.

The rooms do NOT have A/C - but have heaters instead. Make sure while checking in they show you how to operate it.

Food quality is strictly average, but is excellent as compared to the other restaurants in gulmarg.

reviews.author: pranav s
reviews.title: Best Hotel in Indian Hill Station
reviews.text:
I went with my family a few days back, and this hotel was one of the best hotels i have ever visited in the Indian hill stations.
We were booked for a luxury room with balcony and the view was mind-blowing. the view of the snow capped mountains was unbelievable at this time of the year.
The Rooms were great, the food quality was very good, the room service was also unto the standard, the only thing is that when you are having a meal in the restaurant the service was too slow. Except the slow service it was a complete package in the Himalayas.

reviews.author: Mehru B
reviews.title: Gorgeous property!
reviews.text: Khyber, Gulmarg - property and rooms are fantastic. Food and service are also very good. Jacuzzi, sauna and steam room and pool are also lovely. One suggestion - there should be separate small changing rooms in the swimming area. (which do not have a shower or toilet. These are just meant for changing clothes) In the women's side, you are expected to change your clothes either in the shower or in the toilet.

reviews.author: ViralAhmedabad_India
reviews.title: beautiful location
reviews.text:
a luxury property but with service that needs loads to improve. the rooms allow sound to leak in from outside. nice upgradation for sure. food quality and service needs to improve. 

still the best and most expensive place to stay in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: D0shi
reviews.title: Room for improvement
reviews.text:
No doubt, once you enter The Khyber, you feel high. The entrance to the resort is just grand. Once you are in, and if you have a taste of collections,what they have, you just can't stop appreciating. 

But there is a lot more required in SERVICES. It is just POOR. We checked in at 2 PM and had our bookings for two nights, for two rooms. Our one room was not ready till 4 PM. We just waited in our one room. Even after second room was ready, we had to call almost thrice  to have our room keys delivered, and programmed. Ultimately I had to visit personally to the guest relation area to have my room key delivered. The one room which we were given Room No. 3001, did not have any partitions in Bathroom. It was under some renovation, and even a single use of shower by one person, could make the whole bathroom wet and slippery. And it actually did. We complained for almost full day about it, and did ask for compensation for the services not provided to us, all went unanswered. We got the change of room only on next day.

Swimming Pool was under some repair, and we could not enjoy it during our stay for two nights. 

Food menu does not have much change, or does not have more option to choose. Vegetarian desserts were out of stock even at 9.30 am on breakfast menu. But still the food is just good.

BUT>>>BUT>>> that's all.That's the only bad about The Khyber mentioned above...

 Rest of the things are just TOOOOOOOOOO GOOD. The best view, The best feel of stay. Since there is nothing much to do in Gulmarg in June-July, you can have full use of Hotel amenities and can hit the Gym, Have your Spa. We enjoyed a great. Every hotel does have some sort of Service related Problems,and Khyber is not exception. But I would very much strongly recommend this Hotel.

Gondala is though not properly maintained and not clean and though OVER PRICED as Rs.1400/- each for 2 levels,  One must go for it. Do not try Ski in July, and the charges are too much for a small span of ski. We were asked for Rs.2500/- each for Ski, charged for Rs.1500/- each, was not worth it. Some people from other Hotel managed to have the same thing at Rs.800/-. The name Khyber to the local guide makes you pay more. But the Stay is just worth the money. Go for it. They will improve...

reviews.author: Nitish G
reviews.title: need improvement to be a 5star
reviews.text: it is a very gd hotel..no doubt.........my 3 day  stay here was gr8 here.....view from its rooms are also mind blowing. .....bt to mark the standards ...to be called a 5 star....it should be perfect...it lacks at its food....it has only one dine in restaurant for all cusienes.....swimming pool is nt even clean.......staf was even rude

reviews.author: VibhutiGarg
reviews.title: Pristine beauty!
reviews.text:
A wooden architecture covered with snow all around made our stay very pleasant. The day we arrived in Gulmarg, it started snowing though usually at end of March that is not a regular phenomenon but we were lucky to witness snowfall. The property is very well located and at a walking distance from the point of gondoal ride. The kahwah drink which they offer as the welcome drink is palatable. The food is delicious but the service of the staff at the restaurant is not very good. There were just 1-2 waiter at the restaurant to serve people during the day and even during breakfast though there were couple of them but seem a bit confused and thus were taking lot of time or after repeated reminders, dishes were served. The hotel definitely needs to improvise on the same.

The pool was large and it was a pleasant sight to swim when it was snowing outside. However, the pool was functional when we arrived but after taking an hour rest when we finally decided to go for swimming, were informed that there was a problem in heating and thus closed. The spa was refreshing with all the aroma therapy, adding to perfect romantic holiday. The rooms were well equipped and comfortable. Overall a very pleasant stay.

reviews.author: Anuja_Mashruwala
reviews.title: Beautiful location, loved the woody construction and its fragrance!
reviews.text:
We stayed there for 2 nights 3 days. Stay was peaceful & relaxing. Kids also had their well-equipped den- Igloo to spread themselves. The l'occitane Spa was quite refreshing yet routine but the location added its charm though was quite put off with the arrangement for the couple spa therapy. The room wasn't well equipped for the couple therapy. 
The room service was prompt than the restaurant. 
Overall in love with the property.

reviews.author: Akshay B
reviews.title: Beautiful Wooden Palace
reviews.text: We Checked in here for a night, there's no dearth of wood here, wood paneled walls, wood floors, stairs and so on. The main attraction of this place is balconies where you can enjoy stunning views of beautiful Gulmarg. There's also a SPA in this property which have a heated swimming pool, sauna and Jacuzzi pool. My family was quite excited about this idea of swimming in a pool when temperatures out side are quite low. And we enjoyed Jacuzzi pool and steam in sauna room as well. But swimming pool was laced with access of chlorine, and quality of water was bad as well, which left our eyes burning even after few hours of swim. Another painful experience was their sole lift was not working at all, made our experience of staying here quite  tiring. There is no doubts this property is excellent, though they need to manage it in a more professional way.

reviews.author: ar_anupammittal
reviews.title: awesome but incomplete
reviews.text: Strange but true. The Khyber is just awesome property, one of the best wooden cladded castle I have ever visited and enjoyed every corner of it. During our stay last summer, we stayed there for three nights and could realize after first day sight seeing that the place must have much to offer with in he property so started looking for swimming pool, Spa, steam etc but surprisingly nothing was functioning and we were told that the work was on and could not be delivered this season. Since we had nothing else to do, we choose the entertainment room/ theater room for kids at least, that was good but overtly booked in absence of other amenities. I sincerely hope that the same has been taken care and one must check with them before booking this year.

reviews.author: Sathyam R
reviews.title: Oasis in snow
reviews.text:
Khyber with its green roofs and timber walls contrasts well against the backdrop of white snow.
The rooms are spacious with touches of local linen and woodwork. The views from some of the rooms are breath taking. Most guests stay here for couple of nights during summer using it as easy access to the gondola ride, apart from that there is little to do here. There are no restaurants within walking distance so you dine in most of the time. The food is Ok but special mention must be made of Samir and Muzafir at the Cloves restaurant who went beyond the norm in taking care of us

reviews.author: Vinita2601
reviews.title: Gorgeous and Grand
reviews.text: Khyber is everything you have been told. Beautiful and grand. I loved the location and the views. However the best part was the temperature control system... if you are in the resort the outside temperature will not bother you at all. They have used some beautiful Kashmiri design elements in the interiors of the resort. Loved the woodwork, the silks and the carpets. The staff was very helpful. Avoid the l'occitane spa... well made but poor therapists.

reviews.author: Nareshparekh
reviews.title: Excellent view and great location
reviews.text:
Location : Excellent location can walk down to gondola.
Staff : Very very helpful and polite staff.
Rooms : Big and comfortable.As Gulmarg was experiencing snowfall the view was of snow al around the resort.Have an excellent climate control and hence never felt cold anywhere in the hotel premises.
Food : Need to add more variety in the buffet as it is not value for money as the cost compared to other 5star is very high.
Amenities : A very good heated swimming pool and billiards table.Children centre toys or games were non functional a turn off for children.

Worth a stay would surely visit once again with complete family.

reviews.author: Bhavya H
reviews.title: Lovely interiors but non funtional lifts
reviews.text: The khyber is definitely worth a 4 or 5 star if not for the non functional lifts. We stayed in room no  6003 for which you have to climb or get down 6 fleets of stairs. It is nearly impossible if elders are travelling with  you. We stayed for 2 nights and 3 days and had a tough time  climbing up all the time. This is something you dont expect in a hotel of this standard and tariff most importanly.Please enquire before booking your room.The food was okay but the waiters were very disappointing. They took their own jolly time to get us our order.They lack hospitality. It was as if they were doing their duty to get home their salary. The property is really good but needs to be maintained by a professional. Rooms were fine. Bathroom was little congested , otherwise no complaints. It is really close to the gondola ride which is the main attraction in gulmarg. Anyway I loved the property and hope to see improvements in specified fields. Interiors are classy, Iust say. Good luck guys!

reviews.author: Akash Choudhari
reviews.title: Amazing views...Good Hotel....
reviews.text:
Visited Gulmurg after 15 years with the family. There was still plenty of snow which was a pleasant surprise. 

The hotel is well located right next to the Gondola (which is nothing but the cable cars which takes you to the top of the mountain and probably best thing to do). The views are as good as you can get and it has a heated indoor poor with one of the best views you can image (full glass facing the mountains). Hotel rooms are good with greats views but slightly run down but nothing to complain about (probably in such extreme weather the wear and tear is going to be high). The Kashmiri food was very good but make sure you order well in advance (they took 40 mins to get the food). Also you need to have the Kava Tea in the coffee shop (overlooking the mountain) which was the best I have had in all the hotels and restaurants I visited in Kashmir.

I left my bag in the Srinagar airport and Staff was quite helpful in getting it for me. So overall a Good Experience.

reviews.author: Friend2Travel
reviews.title: Breathtaking Views and Decor
reviews.text: The Khyber is a beautiful property, with a prime location. The Gondola ride is very near to the hotel. We were particularly impressed by the decor of the hotel & great views from our room as well as from the lobby.

reviews.author: Chaitanya A
reviews.title: Highlight of Kashmir with breathtaking views and decor
reviews.text:
The Khyber is a beautiful landscaped property, with a prime location. The Gondola ride is very nearby from the hotel.

We were particularly impressed by the decor of the hotel which is done in a traditional Kashmiri style. We enjoyed great views from our room as well as from the lobby. The lobby was well done up. Our rooms also were extremely well done up.
This is a must visit in Gulmarg. Would recommend to visit the hotel and have a meal even if you are not staying the night.

However there were few issues where the management must rectify things-
We found overall professionalism lacking. The service overall was average.
The jacuzzi for the women was not working. The pool was not heated and the staff had no clue how to increase the temperature.
We also found maintenance lacking with high amounts of seepage on the walls and non-functional lifts! We hope that Khyber is able to rectify these problems or else, this property might soon deteriorate.

reviews.author: Amit K
reviews.title: Beautiful Gulmarg, Good Hotel
reviews.text:
Khyber is a well respected property in the Gulmarg region. Evident from a half raised eyebrow from most locals whom you mention it to within the city. A group of us checked in for the weekend. Here are the good and bad, good first:

The Good:
wonderful property, spread out, adequately heated so don't need thick layering inside the hotel. Food across the various cuisines offered is excellent. The menu is quite extensive and above expectation for a hotel in the hills with limited access to raw material and talent. 
The guards at the premises are excellent and helpful - they take initiative - helped me carry my 3 year old child over a steep incline on their own. 
The spa and the pool (which i didnt get to use - did not have swimming gear and they had run out of mens gear for sale) is excellent - the biggest regret I have is not being able to get into the pool. 

The bad:
Housekeeping had to be reminded at 1030am and then again at 230pm to clean room. Bathtub when filled with water had hair floating in it. The upkeep of the rooms is mediocre. The shower head flew out when the water was switched on, I left it on the floor for the housekeeping to see and fix but happened again the next day. Carry your own umbrella - room does not have any and porch had run out. The walls are thin - and you can hear everything from the corridor outside to the floor upstairs - footsteps, baby crying, people laughing - making it difficult to sleep at night. The uncomfortable mattress does not help either. Everything is expensive, I guess because they are the only hotel in this category in gulmarg. There was a electricity fluctuation issue through our stay - was told the hotel transformer had been acting up that week. Power goes frequently and you are in pitch dark from 10 seconds to a few minutes so be prepared. We were 2 adults + 1 toddler in room, I asked for an extra bed was charged another 3,000 Rs.  and the housekeeping guys came and opened the sofa to make it an extra bed - felt robbed. There is a kids play room - with basic stuff - better than not having one at all.

The biggest experience make or break for me is the first point of contact at any check in i.e. reception - here the hotel failed miserably. The check in person feigned ignorance on my credit card companies tie up for an upgrade even though I had it in writing. I understand it is subject to availability but she was of the belief that there is no entitlement only. Was kind of rude until her senior stepped in and took over. 

On the whole a good weekend family property, excellent food, go with low expectations on service and a heavy wallet.

reviews.author: Saurabh_Fadia
reviews.title: Quite a good hotel
reviews.text:
The hotel is located very near the key attraction of Gulmarg - The Gondola. The resort is well designed & has quite good facilities. The food range is not very wide but certainly tasty.
I was there for a conference & hence the number of people were too many (Over 70 - 80) & hence the hotel seemed understaffed. But if you were to visit with a smaller group of even 15  people i think they will be able to provide good service since the staff seemed motivated to serve.
The elevators were present but non functional causing us to be breathless climbing 4 floors in freezing cold everyday

reviews.author: Nirajp
reviews.title: Luxury, Great views - Service could be better
reviews.text:
As soon as you enter this property, one can figure that this is a luxury hotel. Beautiful wooden interiors with beautiful furnishings. The lobby has a coffee shop overlooking the beautiful nature outside. When we reached, it just started snowing and the view was awesome.

Check-in : Check-in process was very quick. No issues

Room - The room is spacious, with almost all rooms having great views. The room has a large LED TV with a separate DTH connection. First hotel in India where I have experienced HD TV and HD DTH connection. There is a clear intent to maintain the luxury quotient. The bathroom is spacious with a separate tub and shower area with top-end bath fittings. The bathroom and room are separated by a half glass panel (covered by blinds) which might not be something which all families would be ok with. A mini-bar and tea / coffee maker.  Overall a good comfortable room

Location :- A 5 mins walk (hike) from the Gondola, the location is perfect. Close but yet not in the midst of crowd.

Food :- The taste was average, including local Kashmiri cuisine. They definitely look at this aspect. The breakfast spread was also not great, though they do offer a complete spread of Indian + Continental breakfast. Room service is very very expensive.

Acitivities :- They have a large game room with XBOX installed. Also a small theater with a DVD collection. There is an indoor heated pool as well.

Service :- This was the disappointing part. The staff doesn't seem to be professionally trained for service at this kind of a luxury hotel. The service was nowhere near 5-star standard. The communication (or lack or it), promptness left lot to be desired. There is lot of scope for improvement in this area. We got a glimpse of this during the check-out process. I had to dial atleast 3-4 times before someone picked up at the reception. Even after this no one turned up to pick the luggage. Finally I had to personally go and request at the reception.

reviews.author: Viineet K
reviews.title: Fantastic Hotel with breath taking views
reviews.text:
Nice and spacious rooms with breath taking view from the room, as soon as you open your eyes in the morning you see lots n lots of snow in winters and lush green gardens in summers and rainy seasons.. In winters if you are lucky enough to be there to witness the snowfall, it's a total bliss!! 

For Skiers GULMARG, Kashmir is paradise and specially for Americans, Europeans, Japanese, Australians and other first world countrymen it is not only a fantastic experience but ''dirt cheap''. Khyber is just next to the Gondola point from where you can go on the top of the snow peaks and for Skiers a 'IDEAL LOCATION'!!

Food is not that great, but good, I would rate it as 6 out of 10.. Service is quite good and the Staff is very friendly & caring..!! Though, the property is just a year old and hope they can maintain the standards for years to come..!! 

All the best to The Khyber team!!

reviews.author: Sanjeev A
reviews.title: Sanjeev aggarwal
reviews.text: We were visit hotel at 31 march for 2 nights resort is excellent,good location just 5 mnts walk to gondola cable,restaurant & food is good but there is nothing to do in the resort if u are single family u wll be bored no fun zone,no dvdplayer in the rooms,no games like ,chess,cards,ludo,there heated pool was not working children's get bored only option see tv at room.

reviews.author: Dino1512
reviews.title: "Gulmarg - Heaven on Earth"
reviews.text:
This was our second trip to Gulmarg. We had been to Gulmarg during summer in June. It was lush green with only the mountain peaks covered in snow. Coming to Gulmarg in March was a completely a different experience. My wife being a travel agent, i knew she would do a thorough research on the places to stay. We eventually chose Khyber as we heard a lot of good reviews about the hotel and its courteous staff. 

It took us some time to reach the hotel as our car had trouble wading through the thick snow on the road, however once we entered the hotel it was just fabulous. The property is the best among the options available. What really stands out is the staff, they don't leave any opportunity to make your stay comfortable. Mr. Aditya Mata and his entire team made our stay memorable. So a big thank you to the entire team at Khyber.

While the location and courteous staff makes it a splendid property to stay, here are few pointers to note:-
1. The property is very close to the Gondola ride. Which is a big advantage
2. It is also very close to the Ski grounds. If you choose some good guides like we had, your experience will be truly awesome
3. Khyber food although not fancy is simple but very good. They have a decent spread of Kashmiri Wazwan for the 3 nights when we were there. However we felt they could do with some lavish spread considering the cost of the stay. Options for Veggies can be little limited.
4. The property does not sell alcohol, but they serve you if you make your own arrangements. Can be little turn off especially in that weather.
5. The bed is hard and the pillows were not comfortable for me, while my wife had no issues. 
6. The view from the rooms are mind blowing. every photo was a post card.
7. The heated pool and the works - steam, sauna & spa is a big plus. 

Overall we had an excellent stay at Khyber and we left Gulmarg with a very heavy heart, only to promise ourselves to come back to "Heaven on earth" some time soon!! Cheers

reviews.author: Rutli
reviews.title: Awesome Stay
reviews.text:
What sets Khyber apart from a lot of other hotels I have stayed in is the attitude of the staff.
the staff here goes way above and beyond call of duty and brings alive the true Kashmir hospitality. A must try for all those who want a feel of home in their stays in hotels

reviews.author: nixongupta
reviews.title: Khyber Hotel and Spa Gulmarg
reviews.text: I was there from the 5th of March to the 9th of March, the Hotel is just fabulous the location the rooms all are perfect nothing to complain, the food is ok nothing too great to rave about and so os the service the service by the waiters and other staff is also very average to ok, but other than that the whole experience in Gulmarg was just fabulous.

reviews.author: RomalSuri
reviews.title: Mesmerising Experience at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Words fall short to describe our 3 nights stay at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa ,Gulmarg .. The whole experience was truly a memorable one and the memories shall be cherished forever !

The moment you step into the hotel ,you feel like you've stepped back in time when living life meant enjoying a cocktail and the lively art of conversation. This hotel has the most friendly staff  and were extremely prompt & courteous.Its truly a luxury experience and a must visit for every avid traveller ..True, the rooms are "extremely cozy & comfy " and each room opens to a breathtaking view .I'm yet to see a more picturesque place in India ..Had a lovely experience at their spa by l'occitane and their other facilities like the gym & swimming pool were top class ..  Don't miss out staying at the Khyber  if you want to truly enhance your Kashmir experience. 

I have been promoting this property to all my near & dear ones , needless to say ,that  speaks volumes about the place ..

"I cannot rave enough & would definitely return again"

Romal Suri 
CEO A.R PLACEMENTS

reviews.author: sswang
reviews.title: Magnificient!
reviews.text: Though we were not residents at the hotel, we used the restaurant services of the hotel during a break while sight seeing. Even though the property was still under construction, we could tell by the look of it that it was magnificent and had the best views in town. This review is really for the Manager & restaurant staff who were very nice, despite just a brief interaction over a cup of Kehwa. They were gracious enough to even provide the tea & snacks on the house! The Manager was kind enough to provide a tour of the hotel to ensure that we would love to stay at the Khyber the next time in Gulmarg!

reviews.author: lm1900
reviews.title: Impeccable Service and Hospitality!
reviews.text:
Would like to start this review by stating just how extraordinary the attitude of the service staff was!
To elaborate, at every instance they were so polite and just out to help and make you more comfortable, right from the doorman to every waiter and other staff.
We were on a Snow package that included our transfers from Srinagar and b/fast and dinner.
As were a group of 10, and the hotel does not serve alchohol, we had carried our own bottles which we would sit in Calabash, an area with tables outside the restaurant in the lobby for hours drinking listening to our music and no one bothered us.
Even if we got some food out of the restaurant to feed the kids, they were adjusting unlike most other hotels which are unnecessarily finicky not looking to the convenience of the guests.

Food
Food was generally good, especially their SHEEKH KABABS were to die for!! However, those we ordered a la carte and food apart from the buffet is expensive.
Buffet had decent variety and food was fairly good, better on some days than others.

Rooms 
rooms are decent, nothing extraordinary but for the remote location of the hotel, I guess good.
BUT even in winter the rooms get very very stuffy and suffocating at night, so much so that we opened the door the first night a bit and then got table fans to circulate air  the following nights.
We did complain and people did come to fix but I think their system doesnt go below 24 degrees into air conditioning, so dont know if it was just our room, or whether changing rooms would have made a difference?
Also goes to show that their insulation so good or the quality of their glass/windows/doors that despite it being below minus outside, still not freezing in the room! 
Mattresses are also ok, not particularly comfortable and pillows very large, heavy and uncomfortable.    
THE MOST IMPORTANT thing is no matter what anyone tells you, please get a HIMALAYAN view room versus the GULMARG view!!!!!!
The room with the balcony makes no differeence in winter as balcony does not get used so though we had it, was not worth paying the price difference. In summer, probably yes!

Room Service too was extremely helpful and willing to finger cut some carrot and cucumber I had carried with me as my 4 year ols has food allergies! 

Spa is run by L'occitane and the facial I had was good and therapist though fairly new and from nagaland but decent.

Jacuzi and indoor pool was also really enjoyed by the kids! 

Overall the staff goes out of their way to satisfy and are very courteous and polite in a very genuine way and not just how the thai do it because they have to or are supposed to!!

All in all would surely go back, just wish they would aircondition the rooms!

Though we enjoyed our stay at the hotel but I believe the hotel is a bit overpriced.

Come fall in love with Kashmir guys

reviews.text:

Gorgeous interiors and part exteriors furnished in stunning wood (Deodar, I suppose), breathtaking view outside the balcony and an awe-inspiring vicinity that make an immortal impression. reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text:
The Khyber hotel is undoubtedly a beautiful place to stay. The balcony room we stayed in was very clean , the bed was extremely comfortable and  the view was stupendous. The staff were all very friendly and very helpful. The food was excellent , my husband had the lamb which was to die for :)
We had two issues with the hotel , one was the checking in procedure , although our booking was for a balcony room with a mountain view they though it would be ok to give us a room on the other side of the hotel until I insisted on a mountain view room. Also a member of staff knocked on our bedroom door to tell us I must go to the front desk and pay immediately , we had paid in advance through our travel agent so this was very upsetting but the issue was quickly sorted and we received an apology for the mistake . I am sure the check in procedure problems will be sorted as the staff gain more experience. We would certainly stay here again.

reviews.author: Ayush Chauhan
reviews.title: If only luxury could buy you everything...
reviews.text:
Suffice to say this is easily the most grand and the largest hotel/ resort in Gulmarg. Great location (minutes away from the Gondola), fantastic views of the hills, grand architecture, lavishly done lobby, spacious rooms, plush interiors. We stayed in their premium rooms (with attached balcony) and it was a memorable stay (the rooms are a little small for the money charged - but not unmanageably so). This was my third trip to Gulmarg and I am amazed by the warmth and hospitality of the people there - Khyber was no different. Their service was prompt - and the brutal yardstick for that is warm milk at 7am for our 20 month old daughter. They didn't let us down once ! :) 

We were in Khyber late September 2013 and the spa / indoor swimming pool / gymnasium was still coming up. They took good care to ensure that the guests weren't bothered by it and I believe they were on track to have it up and running by this winter season. 
 
But like I said, if only luxury could buy you everything.. sigh ! And I must put a caveat here - that this part of the review is very personal and therefore not everyone would agree with it. For a place as charming as Gulmarg, its a pity that Khyber makes it slightly impersonal for you. And for a resort this size and lavish, it is not surprising. So the food was good but not great - infact just a few kms away is the oldest hotel in Gulmarg - Nedous - where we were served by two old, jovial butlers who have been with Nedous for the last 35 years. And the difference became evident - in the conversations that were missing, in the home-made mutton that was distinctly Kashmiri, in the charm that slightly rustic, undone exteriors have.

So in that sense, Khyber fails to provide the warmth and culture of Gulmarg. What works for it is the luxury and the dramatic surroundings. What doesn't is the intimacy, warmth and culture that should have been there - and only for that reason you also end up feeling that it is over-priced. I wouldn't be going back without trying some other places first.
