reviews.text:
The Khyber @ Gulmarg is a fantastic property, only recently built, at a beautiful location. As soon as you enter the hotel, you can see that it is a class apart in all respects. From the Furnishings to the paintings, to the rooms and the flooring, everything is tastefully chosen and done up. The Staff here is very courteous and polite. Food is lovely. However, there is no bar in the hotel, which may be noted. There is a kids area, comprising of a trampoline, swing and see-saw, which my daughter loved. Further, there are other entertainment options like the snooker, carom, etc, This area was under construction.

All in all, we had a fantastic experience at this hotel and would highly recommend it. I would even go so far to say this IS THE BEST HOTEL IN GULMARG.

reviews.author: PreethiNat
reviews.title: Pricey!
reviews.text: We stayed for a night at the Khyber. The interiors are beautifully done but the wooden flooring is quite slippery. The staff were extremely cordial and very courteous. The welcome tea was very refreshing and the servicing staff took extra care to satisfy us.  However, the food did not agree especially the fresh fruit juices that were offered during dinner. The stay was overall good but the bad experience was after checking out. We had missed our cellphone and tried to trace it back but the numbers were not reachable. The staff were also very curt to us over phone. The after service could definitely be improved. Overall good stay, but not worth the hefty amount we paid for it.

reviews.author: saurabhkhabia
reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Hotel as just started some time back wen we visited so hotel staff seemed fighting for time.  They were short of staff to. Food very few options for vegetarian. Rooms on levels which r down r not good.  Gondola Ride in gulmarg is good.

reviews.author: RekhaChoudhry
reviews.title: Good product, Fabulous locales!!
reviews.text:
My son had booked us here and I was a bit skeptical about staying here given that Gulmarg had seen the opening of this hotel only a very short while ago! Having said that, I was pleasantly surprised to see that this hotel was affiliated to the SLHW and thought to myself that the affiliation obviously held some merit to the hotel's services.
The product simply blows one away! Wafting smells of sweet saffron laced kahwa and the nuttiness of the walnut furniture are enough to create a mesmerising effect. The rooms are large and redolent with Afghan and Kashmiri influences. Large sunken baths overlooking the Affarwat mountains are sure to ease out any strain that one might have felt while coming to the hotel.
Our stay was however peppered with some unwanted faux pas. The toilet in the room backed up and nearly overflowed at around midnight. The complaint was however, attended to quite promptly.
The service at Cloves (the all-day dining restaurant) was pathetically slow and lacked attention and coordination. We received our drinks after we had finished our soups and appetisers. And this is despite us being the only three guests at the restaurant. This laxity was however, made up quite well by the food, which I must say was great, both in portions and taste.
Overall, I would say this was a great retreat and a must visit for people coming over to Gulmarg.

reviews.author: rmanroa
reviews.title: Resort with a view
reviews.text:
Stayed there from 29 Aug - 30 Aug. We were allotted 3 luxury balcony rooms (east wing) on the first floor. The rooms were very modern, well maintained with flat screen television and tea/coffee warm kettle, centrally air conditioned, etc. Similarly the bathroom was fantastic with a nice shower section and a bath tub. The only let down was the view, an absolute disappointment. On opening the curtains all we could see is trees and the parking complex!!! 
The breakfast spread in the hotel was great. South India, Pav Bhaji, cereals, milk shakes, juices, sausages, baked beans, cappuchino, kahva etc... Our first night dinner at Cloves restaurant was good. We opted for ala carte. Most of the dishes are priced in the range of Rs 600-700 plus tax. Our next days dinner at Nouf (open only for Dinner) was great. Its an open air grill restaurant and definitely pricier (Rs 800-Rs 1000 per dish plus tax) but the food was fantastic. At Nouf we can bring our own alcohol and they are happy to serve it to us. This restaurant has limited capacity and tends to go full. Hence prior reservations recommended.
The hotel also has a cigar and sheesha lounge.

reviews.author: RahulC
reviews.title: Good property but Improvements needed!
reviews.text:
We were a group of 13 adults and 3 children. We stayed at this property for 2 nights (Check in 15th Aug and Check out 17th Aug). I searched for the best tariff for this hotel on online travel websites and my regular travel agent in Mumbai. But I got the best deal from Sawhney Tours and Travels, Srinagar.

We had booked 6 premier mountain view rooms for Rs 12,500 per room per night which included tax and breakfast. Out of the 6 rooms, 3 of our rooms were upgraded to Luxury Balcony rooms.

Before our stay, I did write to Mr Alex (G.M.) about looking forward to a great stay. He was prompt in his reply and assured us of a good stay. Even Mr Arun (Director of food and beverages) got in touch with me to enquire if we had any special dietary requirements. A good start!!
 
Our stay at this hotel could clearly be divided into two different experiences. To begin with we arrived at the hotel at 4.30pm.We were allotted 3 luxury balcony rooms (east wing) on the first floor and 3 premier mountain rooms on the minus one level (This was after requesting for all 6 rooms on the lobby level as we had senior citizens and children in our group and the hotel lift is still not operational). The premier mountain view rooms are around 386 sq. feet. The rooms were very modern, well maintained with flat screen television and tea/coffee warm kettle, centrally air conditioned, etc. Similarly the bathroom was fantastic with a nice shower section and a bath tub. But on close inspection the bath tub had brown dirt stains which was a downer. The phone and television was not working!!! I had to personally walk to the reception to inform about the problems and they said they would have it rectified. The view from the mountain view rooms was an absolute disappointment. On opening the curtains all we could see is trees and the parking complex!!! In the defense of the hotel management we faced cloudy and rainy weather during our stay in Gulmarg which had curtailed the views to an extent.

By dinner time, nobody had yet come to rectify the above issues. I,my wife and my 6 month old daughter went for dinner and this time we were clear about our disappointment. Fortunately, we ran into Mr Arun and Mr Deepak who understood our concerns and promptly changed our room to a luxury balcony room (east wing) on the lobby level. From then on, our stay only got better.

The luxury balcony rooms (568 sq. feet) are absolute luxury. Huge rooms and bathrooms with a wonderful balcony overlooking the valley. If there are no budget constraints I would definitely advice people to take balcony rooms but in the south wing. The east wing rooms have a good view but the view from the south wing is definitely better.

I happened to meet Mr Alex the next day. He explained that since the last 3 days it was raining heavily in Gulmarg hence they were facing issues with their telephone and televisions. He acknowledged the problem of the bath tub which he said was a problem in their system which he was going to completely overhaul! 

The breakfast spread in the hotel was great. South India, Pav Bhaji, cereals, milk shakes, juices, sausages, baked beans, cappuchino, kahva etc... Our first night dinner at Cloves restaurant was average. They have a buffet (Rs 1600 p.h.) but we opted for ala carte. Most of the dishes are priced in the range of Rs 600-700 plus tax. Our next days dinner at Nouf (open only for Dinner) was great. Its an open air grill restaurant and definitely pricier (Rs 800-Rs 1000 per dish plus tax) but the food was fantastic. At Nouf we can bring our own alcohol and they are happy to serve it to us. This restaurant has limited capacity and tends to go full. Hence prior reservations recommended.

Vodafone postpaid subscribers will not get network in the hotel except in the balcony of the luxury balcony rooms. There is full network when u exit the hotel. The hotel also has a cigar and sheesha lounge. The hotel does laundry for children clothes at 50 % of the normal laundry tariff. 

Gulmarg does not have wine shops. No hotel in Gulmarg serves alcohol.

The spa and swimming pool are not operational. They have a private theatre which unfortunately was booked during our stay. They have a small children's activity play area.

Mr Alex and his team have a great property. I am sure they will iron out the glitches faced by us. I would recommend a stay at this property when all their facilities are operational (January 2014 onwards).

reviews.author: RCR1000
reviews.title: Family Holiday in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
We stayed 2 nights in this hotel. The staff were very friendly & helpful. 
The view from the upper floor was fantastic but the lower floor had no views. 
Unfortunately a number of facilities for children were not working - & we had a large group of
Young children. The pool was under repair!
The quality of food & selection were good. Overall,good experience. 
Recommend mountain view rooms on upper floor - worth the extra cost. 
Beds were too soft!

reviews.title: A wonderfully relaxing holiday.....
reviews.text: The Khyber Himalayan Resort was a big surprise to me....I never expected it to have service which was outstanding, superb staff and excellent hospitality.  Rooms were well appointed and the bathrooms were nice! Service at the restaurants was very good and food selection completely met our expectation.  My husband and I recommend a stay here for anyone who wants to visit Gulmarg...we truly loved it and will come back here, hopefully soon...

reviews.author: Arjun S
reviews.title: At par with any big 5 star hotels
reviews.text:
We stayed in khyber for two nights and were very well looked after.it has all the facilities which a high end hotel should have and the spa and swimming pool is expected to be ready by October. 
Excellent facilities complemented by a very highly trained staff. 
Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Darvish
reviews.title: Unexpected Luxury nestled in Himalayas...
reviews.text:
Gulmarg tends to be touristy and crammed during summers but Khyber’s location ensures that you’re far and away from the madding crowds besides offering you with some of the best views of the layered mountains and the mist. This is one place that will overwhelm you with its sheer grand feel, as you seldom come across a luxurious resort of this size in the hill stations. Mostly, we expect a simple & functional lobby and basic room standards, but a few addresses like this have truly raised the bar. 

Don’t miss the traditional Kashmiri Kahwa on arrival while their staff completes the check-in formalities. It’s very intimate and comfortable lounge at the far end of the extended lobby, with large bay windows separating sunlit verandahs overlooking the hills. The rooms have the typical comforts of five-star hotel and resorts in other parts of the country, just that you would not have expected it here. The décor is creatively inspired by local Kashmiri artistic motifs. However, despite being a new hotel, some structural elements had maintenance issues like the sliding door between the wardrobe and toilet. 

We had a large spacious balcony sit out attached to our room, a perfect place to brood and admire the blissful views. With Kashmir having extended daylight in summers, you have the flexibility to optimize your hours between the balcony and bathtub as the view gets replicated from toilet as well.

We preferred taking all our meals at the resort itself. The breakfast and weekend dinner buffet spread was extensive and a-la-carte menu had some interesting local cuisine choices. Service was a need area at times, as the staff was not well-trained to be attentive or make eye contacts. They looked busy all the time without really attending to the guests. Service issue was also faced when we had to request thrice for something as simple as keeping an extra duvet in the room. 

Otherwise, the team is very knowledgeable to interact with and seemed to have background experiences with some of the leading International hotel brands. The resort management also went out of their way to arrange Gondola tickets for us, a must-do experience if you are in Gulmarg. This saved us from the frustration of getting into long queues. We were advised to come back in winters, esp. February to experience another aspect of Gulmarg. 

Khyber is a destination in itself and you’re tempted to be back here soon, hopefully, their spa would be operational soon.

reviews.author: supermehra
reviews.title: Excellent service & well appointed rooms
reviews.text:
Possibly the best hotel in Gulmarg, the Khyber is an excellent, brand new property. The hotel has the feel of a "wood cabin" with great views of the mountains & woods. 

Pros:
1. Located very close to the Gondola starting point & the golf course. 
2. Service is outstanding with eager to please staff.
3. Rooms are brand new and were the most comfortable in Kashmir. 
4. Food though limited in choice, was generally decent.
5. Chaikash their tea lounge is a great hang out and serves lovely kawa. Also decent cappuccino.  
6. The room we had, overlooked the hotel gardens which are perfect to relax in. Hotel also does bonfires on request for an additional charge. 
7. Kids have a cinema, trampoline, billiards table (poorly maintained), garden area to play in, all of which keeps them busy.  
8. We shared our suite with 2 kids, which worked out well. The room balcony was spectacular. 

Cons:
1. The hotel has some construction still underway. Can be noisy if you are nearer the construction. 
2. The approach to the hotel is cluttered with ponies which make a real mess. No real fault of the hotel, Gulmarg is just like that.  
3. The hotel restaurant was shut which meant that you had a choice between the buffet & an open air continental restaurant. The buffet tries hard, but isn't very good. It also gets boring if you are going to eat three meals times 3 days in the same room! Gulmarg has no other real options outside the hotel. 
4. The lack of authentic Kashmiri food was our greatest disappointment. When in Kashmir why would you want to eat continental? Perhaps for the europeans who come skiing in the winter!
5. NO ALCOHOL...... so BYOB!

Overall, I would highly recommend Khyber.

reviews.author: Amit K
reviews.title: Superb property with great views
reviews.text:
Newly built, superbly done up hotel. Hotel owner seems to have spent a fortune in building it (some parts still under construction). Spa is still to be operational. 

Stayed in a room with balcony - comparable to the best. 

Had the best Kahwa tea of my trip (which was offered while check-in was being done). However, food quality was generally not up to the mark, maybe its early days.

reviews.author: CHANDRAChandigarh
reviews.title: Good for Winter
reviews.text:
Stayed 4th & 5th June 2013

The check in was painfully slow, we were offered some kahwa and then totally forgotten about. The rooms are nice. However almost half of the rooms have balconies for which the hotel charges approx Rs 3000 extra.  Rooms with No balconies have a big glazed wall for a good view of the forest beyond, but then the glass was never cleaned.
 In this hotel we had to go down 2 floors to reach our room. Provision for lift is there which was not installed as yet.
The spa is also not functional yet. The business centre is also lacking in many aspects. No newspapers delivered to the rooms in the morning.
 Quality of food is good and the service in the restaurant is good. 
Housekeeping is poor. Hot water tap was delivering tepid water, while cold water tap was dry. After complaint  mechanics did come over to fix up, though the job done was not perfect.
The location is very good. 
This hotel has all the services under one roof, which is very important in winter when it is snowing outside.
My Nephew who was also with us on this trip and had stayed in Highland park hotel many times earlier had booked this hotel for a change. His was of the opinion that in Summer, Highland Park would be a better choice, while in winter this Khyber Resort  would be OK.

reviews.author: NEERAJ2791
reviews.title: EXCELLENT LOCATION GOOD HOTEL
reviews.text: Good new property still under construction. Staff was really good and cooperative and presentable. Food quality is really good with cleanliness in the restaurant. Rooms balconies gives a lush green views of deodar trees. Only problem we faced was the smell of new wood work polish in the lobby, our room was changed after request to manager. Really value for money

reviews.author: Gujjarwalprince
reviews.title: Great Grand Property at Great Grand Place.
reviews.text: Wonderful Hotel . newly built . Interiors are like a palace . Location is the negative point as it doesn't face the grasslands of Gulmarg but otherwise the rooms the staff the interiors the ambience is 7 star . One really wondwrs that such an iconic place excists in a place like Gulmarg . Hats off the the Owners of the hotel. They hav put in their heart in this property.

reviews.author: Loyalka_S
reviews.title: Best hotel in gulmarg
reviews.text: The hotel is best in gulmarg, the rooms are beautiful, we stayed there for 2 days, the food was awesome. The view from the room was very good. The hotel staff were courteous & we got a good service. Their restaurant does not very a very elaborate menu for vegetarians but the veg options they have are good.

reviews.author: Kalrak
reviews.title: Good Resort
reviews.text: We stayed for two nights at Khyber Gulmarg. It is a newly built property. Infrastructure is excellent but services need to pick up. Views are excellent. It is not value for money. the price charged is exorbitant as same quality of room can be had at much lesser price in other cities of the country.

reviews.author: agarwalmohit96
reviews.title: Excellent Place But Poor Service
reviews.text:
We stayed in Kyber Hotel for 2 nights. I must say the hotel is built in an excellent manner, however, they lack proper guest service. We took almost 2 hours to check in in spite of prior booking. We were received at the gate and made to seat in the tea lounge while our rooms were allotted, however after 35 minutes when I approached the helpdesk, they were not even aware of our waiting. We were then allotted rooms 2 floors below, with the elevators "YET TO START". We refused to take the rooms as my uncle is a heart patient and can't climb so many stairs. They upgraded our rooms (Which is a good thing) but took additional 1 hour to do so. Slightly disorganized. The food is gud but if you opt for ala carte than be prepared to be served cold food.

If I am to rate the hotel, than it would be 4.5 out of 5 but service would be 2.5 out of 5.0. They may not get repeated customers if they continue like this.

reviews.author: Avi_loves_travel
reviews.title: Exceptional in Winter
reviews.text:
Best luxury ski resort in Kashmir. Stayed here in winter , February 2013. The gondola to the ski slopes is just below the resort, walking distance which makes it very convenient for skiers.
 
The resort is very well made, offers multi cuisine restaurant and great views from the balcony views. The rooms are comfortable, and well heated for winter.

It offers large close areas for groups and most recommended.

reviews.author: Tender0
reviews.title: Ask and get
reviews.text:
A beautiful property with the best of services. I was very disappointed by the initial allotment of the room (in the basement, near a noisy laundry room?) and lacklustre reception.  I did not hesitate in being vocal about my disappointment and things changed. We were relocated...to a room with breathtaking view of the snow-capped mountains and a valley of trees from the window and its balcony..! Prompt, flawless and obliging service. Very cordial staff. Impressive spread for dinner as well as breakfast..Upon my request the live egg station chef cooked a very fluffy omelette in a very innovative style. Head chef dropped by to check all is well. 
Only caveat - the facilities at the hotel were not yet operational. They need to introduce more in house activities. The kahwa reception was good.

reviews.author: imrandp
reviews.title: Excellent Location, Limited options but a greedy management !
reviews.text:
this property being a member of the SLH group boasts of excellent infrastructure, like other SLH properties. however there are some major flaws too ! we stayed for 3 days in end of may 2013 in balcony room no. 2019 - first floor. the property is located slightly above the Gondola boarding station gate which is past the taxi stand with horses blocking the main road leading to the property. Secondly the most annoying factor is that the management has installed mobile phone jammers high up on a pine tree which works by blocking all mobile phones & wifi above the lobby level; in spite of full signal one cannot make or receive calls. This has been done so that the guests staying in the property use the room telephone & pay the inflated long distance charges. The mobile phone operators whose fake full signal one will receive when within the hotel are Aircel, Airtel & Cellone (BSNL POSTPAID).

The staff are also over worked & work beyond their normal shift hours & with no lift in the property, it is really physically challenging for them too especially in peak season ! The spa & swimming pool are not yet ready but noise levels for the on-going construction activity during day time is low, hence that's tolerable.

the f&b options for veg & non-veg are limited & highly priced, however the food is tasty. waffle counter missing in the breakfast hall & buffet lunch & dinner are prices @ 1600/- per person but with a limited spread. the kava served in the lobby is excellent but not the original Kashmiri kava as its without tea leaves ! the room temperature cannot be increased beyond 24 deg C and that's a problem for kids who would like to sleep at 27 deg C, the most comfortable temperature. in-room digital temperature controller though is of high quality and at par with other SLH properties like Wild Flower Hall of Oberoi above Shimla !

Presently the best in Gulmarg, hence full occupancy.. and since its a new property the minor issues should hopefully be sorted out soon ! Getting your own vehicle & keeping it with you will help as car hire options are limited too !

reviews.author: jyotigupta105
reviews.title: Best Hotel in Gulmarg
reviews.text: Situated in Gulmarg, Kashmir, this hotel was a 2.5 hour drive from Srinagar. The property is beautiful and a lot of wood has been used in its construction. The rooms facing the snow-covered mountains have a much better view so do specify in advance at the time of booking, else you might regret getting the other view. Although I was under the assumption, thanks to my travel agent, that there was a working spa, beauty salon and pool, I was a bit disappointed that these services have not yet begun and are still under construction and might start only from September 2013. I was looking forward to a relaxing time using the spa services and their indoor heated pool, but I guess that will have to wait for my next trip. Also, they can do a better job with the garden- there were hardly any flowers in bloom. The food is excellent- breakfast buffet, lunch and dinner, despite just one restaurant. The staff is very courteous, helpful and friendly. On reaching, we were served an excellent kashmiri kahwa. They have a small section in the lobby called 'chaikash' which is a station to serve all-day coffee, tea, snacks etc. and I enjoyed the lovely hot chocolate every day of my trip here. The hotel does not have a bar. Overall, a lovely hotel built in a beautiful region, surrounded by a view of snow-capped mountains. Away from the scorching 45 degrees heat of my hometown Delhi, it was a lovely change with perfect weather. Definitely recommend Khyber to all visiting Gulmarg

reviews.author: gvicky
reviews.title: "Fantasctic Hotel "
reviews.text:
I opted for Khyber Hotels in Gulmarg after reading favorable reviews by other travelers. I too was not disappointed. The staff was humble. The staff(from manager to cleanliness staff) will notice you and greet you even when you are roaming in the hotel gallery.
I stayed in Luxury Balcony Room. Though The Restaurant is not too spacious but the service staff maintained and manged the restaurant in a perfect way specially Rajeev & Deepak. We had a great time staying at the resort... The service was impeccable... 

The Food is bit expensive .
Room Tip: All the rooms have good view. This Hotel is in the middle of the valley.. so you will see great view.

reviews.author: friend777
reviews.title: The Hotel is just WOW..but........
reviews.text:
Good Luxury room, guess its the one of the best hotels i have stayed in my life  
View was good
Food was very bad and extremely expensive ( avoid eating there as it not worth at all )
we were charged Rupees 1600 for a buffet dinner with only veg food which was tasteless and with very few choice of starters and main course 
Fitness center and spa not started yet 
Its very close to the gandola ride
Service was very good
Staff were pleasant and helpful
Mobile phones dont work in this hotel as there is no network, Hotel Internet is usually not working

reviews.author: khan22
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text:
It's a review that comes with a red warning light...
The hotel is amazingly located and beautifully made. It is a place I would strongly recommend to anyone who wants to have a great time. Majorly wood,  some Glass, metal and papier mache interiors make you want to live there for a while before you move on.
RED ALERT: The food is horrible and EX..P..EnSiii...VE. If you are staying here try to either eat out or order basic meal. The taste is not worth half the price.
The staff is extremely pleasant. Tariq  from the hukkah bar is a knowledgeable young man who is also very kind to give you the right advice when asked for.
Deepak from the restaurant is pleasant and kind enough to make you comfortable and does his bit to make things easier for you.

reviews.author: Subodh V
reviews.title: Paradise in gulmarg
reviews.text:
My first trip to gulmarg could not Hv been better
We were fortunate to experience snow on first may which I am told is quite unusual
Coming to this beautiful property which has been recently opened our stay was extremely enjoyable
We occupied room no 2001 on the first floor which offers breathtaking views of the snow clad mountains .The rooms itself are large open with a large toilet which also has a view of the mountains.The only issue was the over heating of the rooms and difficulty in adjusting the temperature 
The reception area ,the lounge, and the cigar corner are all well located cozy with great views
The staff is still raw and need more training and polishing 
The food was good They do not Hv a Kashmiri chef and therefore the local cuisine was good but not outstanding
One negative issue was the non availability of Vodaphone signal in the hotel 
All in all a wonderful resort which will certainly invite repeat visits

reviews.author: Dilshad M
reviews.title: The 1st luxury resort in Gulmarg
reviews.text: Great place with an extremely professional staff. Only had lunch here but really an experience in class. Just what Gulmarg needed. I have been going to Gulmarg for skiing for the last 25 years and was happy to see the Khyber.

reviews.author: entdelhi
reviews.title: finally gulmarg gets what it deserves!
reviews.text:
at the outset i would like to confess that we did not stay here - came to check out the property because we were looking for an alternative to our hotel we were unhappy at.
it is located at a height, close to the gondola ski lift where the serious skiers would want to be.
since the property is very new, they do not have protocols set in place for skiers - people were entering with their ski boots and ski sticks - which must be murder on the flooring as well as carpeting! they need to set up a changing room/ lounge for skiers to change their footwear etc.
The central atrium is awesome with a high dome, wooden flooring, thick carpets and walls adorned with great paintings.
we sat in the tea lounge and ordered the kashmiri tea - ' kahwa' and it was delicious - flavoured with saffron and served with sliced almonds on the side.
had a chat with the hotel manager who was knowledgeable, pleasant, helpful and passionate about his role - the plan is to set up a spa as well as a year round swimming pool soon. he proudly announced that the property is already a member of the 'small luxury hotel' group - a great honour.
we dined at the coffee shop - the menu is extensive, compared to what was till now available at Gulmarg. The order got confused - they got us stuff we had not ordered, but were prompt to rectify.
a great property, very very new, hopefully with a great future!

reviews.author: DYPP
reviews.title: Another reason to visit paradise.
reviews.text: We spend a couple of hours at the Gorgeous property on 02nd Jan 2013. By far the best property in the region with Amazing Views and a great way to be introduced to Kashmiri Hospitality and Architecture. Rooms are well appointed and spacious can feel the teething issues for a new product. We wish it success and look forward to returning back soon for a few nights.

reviews.author: Sujit B
reviews.title: Landmark property in Kashmir
reviews.text:
I was the first guest to check-in when the hotel opened and I half expected everything to fall apart as most hotels do on the day of opening. I was pleasantly surprised to find that despite all odds (they were snowed in) - they had their act together. The best parts first: It is built on traditional Kashmiri style - lots of wood and more wood; local carpets and decor. Brownie point for keeping the tradition alive. They had more than 80% locals as their staff; again a brownie point for giving an opportunity to the local youth. They had still not been fully trained and they bumbled around a bit and this is exactly what was endearing - genuine people in a hotel not acting like hoteliers! Food was very good; the rooms was excellent and the view was to die for.

Here are few thing that they need to watch out for: 1. Remove art pieces from the lobby - they make it look like a local shop. 2. Add more lights in the lobby. Ensure staff wearing clean dress and shoes AND clean socks that don't smell. Remove the small carpets placed under the table in the room - they can trip and cause someone serious harm (they slip on the polished floor). 3. Keep people to constantly clean the wooden stairs. Inspect each rooms for small flaws (the shower plate in my rooms was skewed).

But go - stay there even if for one night (they are priced steep) and you wont regret it!
